create or replace function public.match_events_var_cancel() returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path to '' as $$ declare v_m record; v_side_home boolean; v_delta int; v_home int; v_away int; v_scorer text; begin if old.event_type = new.event_type or old.event_type not in ('goal', 'goal_cancelled') or new.event_type not in ('goal', 'goal_cancelled') then return new; end if; select id, status, home_team_id, away_team_id, home_score, away_score into v_m from public.matches where id = new.match_id; if v_m.id is null then return new; end if; -- Golün yazıldığı taraf (kendi kalesine golde rakip). v_side_home := (new.team_id = v_m.home_team_id) <> coalesce(new.is_own_goal, false); v_delta := case when new.event_type = 'goal_cancelled' then -1 else 1 end; v_home := greatest(coalesce(v_m.home_score, 0) + case when v_side_home then v_delta else 0 end, 0); v_away := greatest(coalesce(v_m.away_score, 0) + case when v_side_home then 0 else v_delta end, 0); update public.matches set home_score = v_home, away_score = v_away where id = new.match_id; -- Bildirim yalnız iptalde ve maç sürerken. if new.event_type = 'goal_cancelled' and v_m.status in ('live', 'halftime') then select trim(coalesce(name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(surname, '')) into v_scorer from public.players where id = new.player_id; perform public.push_send( public.match_audience(new.match_id, false), 'VAR: Gol iptal', public.match_score_text(new.match_id, v_home, v_away) || ' · ' || case when new.minute is not null then new.minute::text || '''' || ' ' else '' end || coalesce(nullif(v_scorer, ''), 'Gol') || ' golü iptal edildi', '/', 'goal-' || new.match_id ); end if; return new; end; $$

create or replace function public.link_match_highlights(p_match_id uuid) returns int language plpgsql security definer set search_path to '' as $$ declare m record; r record; v_linked int := 0; v_used_events uuid[] := '{}'; v_used_hl uuid[] := '{}'; begin select id, home_team_id, away_team_id into m from public.matches where id = p_match_id; if m.id is null then return 0; end if; for r in with goals as ( select e.id, e.minute, case when coalesce(e.is_own_goal, false) then case when e.team_id = m.home_team_id then m.away_team_id else m.home_team_id end else e.team_id end as scoring_team from public.match_events e where e.match_id = p_match_id and e.event_type = 'goal' and e.minute is not null and not exists (select 1 from public.match_highlights h where h.match_event_id = e.id) ), hls as ( select h.id, h.minute, h.team_id from public.match_highlights h where h.match_id = p_match_id and h.match_event_id is null and h.status <> 'rejected' and h.kind = 'goal' and h.minute is not null ) select g.id as event_id, h.id as hl_id, abs(g.minute - h.minute) as diff from goals g join hls h on abs(g.minute - h.minute) <= 2 and (h.team_id is null or h.team_id = g.scoring_team) order by abs(g.minute - h.minute), h.minute loop if r.event_id = any(v_used_events) or r.hl_id = any(v_used_hl) then continue; end if; update public.match_highlights set match_event_id = r.event_id where id = r.hl_id and match_event_id is null; v_used_events := v_used_events || r.event_id; v_used_hl := v_used_hl || r.hl_id; v_linked := v_linked + 1; end loop; return v_linked; end; $$

k int; r int; w int; v_arr uuid[]; v_rot uuid[]; v_home uuid; v_away uuid; v_match uuid; v_date date; v_status public.match_status; v_hs int; v_as int; v_side int; v_team_id uuid; v_opp uuid; v_starters uuid[]; v_jersey := array[1,2,3,4,5,6,8,7,10,9,11,13,14,19]; end if; v_squad := array_length(v_pos, 1); insert into public.seasons ( league_id, name, start_date, end_date, city, country, is_active, is_default, number_of_groups, teams_per_group, match_period_duration, starting_player_count, sub_player_count, number_of_player_changes, is_double_round) values ( p_league, p_season_name, p_first_date - 7, p_first_date + 7 * (p_per_group + 2), 'İstanbul', 'Türkiye', true, false, v_n, p_per_group, p_period, p_starting, v_squad - p_starting, p_changes, false) returning id into v_season; for i in 1..p_per_group loop k := (g - 1) * p_per_group + i; insert into public.teams (name, first_color, second_color) values (p_teams[k], c_colors[1 + (k - 1) % array_length(c_colors, 1)], '#FFFFFF') returning id into v_team; insert into public.season_teams (team_id, season_id, group_id) values (v_team, v_season, v_group); v_arr := v_arr || v_team; for r in 1..v_squad loop insert into public.players ( name, surname, birth_date, main_position, preferred_foot) values ( p_first_names[1 + floor(random() * array_length(p_first_names, 1))::int], c_last_names[1 + floor(random() * array_length(c_last_names, 1))::int], make_date(p_birth_from + floor(random() * (p_birth_to - p_birth_from + 1))::int, 1 + floor(random() * 12)::int, 1 + floor(random() * 28)::int), v_pos[r], case when random() < 0.75 then 'Sağ' else 'Sol' end) returning id into v_player; haftalar cumartesi. v_rot := v_arr; for w in 1..(p_per_group - 1) loop v_date := p_first_date + 7 * (w - 1); for i in 1..(p_per_group / 2) loop if (w + i) % 2 = 0 then v_home := v_rot[i]; v_away := v_rot[p_per_group + 1 - i]; else v_home := v_rot[p_per_group + 1 - i]; v_away := v_rot[i]; end if; v_status := case when w <= p_played_weeks then 'finished'::public.match_status else 'notStarted'::public.match_status end; v_hs := null; if v_status = 'finished' then insert into public.match_media (match_id, media_type, url) values (v_match, 'Maç Yayın Linki', p_stream_url); v_motm := null; v_motm_team := null; for v_side in 1..2 loop v_team_id := case v_side when 1 then v_home else v_away end; v_opp := case v_side when 1 then v_away else v_home end; v_goals := case v_side when 1 then v_hs else v_as end; select array_agg(player_id order by id) filter (where rn <= p_starting), array_agg(player_id order by id) filter (where rn > p_starting) into v_starters, v_bench from ( select stp.id, stp.player_id, row_number() over (order by stp.id) as rn from public.season_team_players stp where stp.season_id = v_season and stp.team_id = v_team_id ) s; -- Gol atma olasılığı forvetlerde yüksek; kaleci gol atmaz. v_weighted := '{}'; v_outfield := v_starters[2:p_starting]; for k in 2..p_starting loop v_weighted := v_weighted || array_fill( v_starters[k], array[case v_pos[k] when 'Forvet' then 6 when 'On Numara' then 4 when 'Kanat' then 3 when 'Orta Saha' then 2 else 1 end]); end loop; for k in 1..v_goals loop v_scorer := v_weighted[1 + floor(random() * array_length(v_weighted, 1))::int]; v_assist := null; if random() < 0.65 then v_assist := v_weighted[1 + floor(random() * array_length(v_weighted, 1))::int]; if v_assist = v_scorer then v_assist := null; end if; end if; insert into public.match_events ( match_id, team_id, player_id, assist_player_id, event_type, minute, is_own_goal) values (v_match, v_team_id, v_scorer, v_assist, 'goal', 1 + floor(random() * v_full)::int, false); if v_motm is null and (v_goals > case v_side when 1 then v_as else v_hs end or (v_side = 2 and v_motm_team is null)) then v_motm := v_scorer; v_motm_team := v_team_id; end if; end loop; -- Sarı kartlar; bazen ikinci sarı, nadiren direkt kırmızı. v_carded := '{}'; for k in 1..c_card_dist[1 + floor(random() * 8)::int] loop v_scorer := v_outfield[1 + floor(random() * (p_starting - 1))::int]; if v_scorer = any(v_carded) then continue; end if; v_carded := v_carded || v_scorer; v_min := 5 + floor(random() * (v_full - 15))::int; insert into public.match_events (match_id, team_id, player_id, event_type, minute) values (v_match, v_team_id, v_scorer, 'yellow_card', v_min); if random() < 0.10 then insert into public.match_events (match_id, team_id, player_id, event_type, minute) values (v_match, v_team_id, v_scorer, 'yellow_card', least(v_full, v_min + 5 + floor(random() * 10)::int)); end if; end loop; if random() < 0.07 then v_scorer := v_outfield[1 + floor(random() * (p_starting - 1))::int]; if not (v_scorer = any(v_carded)) then insert into public.match_events (match_id, team_id, player_id, event_type, minute) values (v_match, v_team_id, v_scorer, 'red_card', 10 + floor(random() * (v_full - 10))::int); end if; end if; -- Oyuncu değişiklikleri (çıkan: player_id, giren: sub_in_player_id). for k in 1..least(2, coalesce(array_length(v_bench, 1), 0)) loop v_out := v_outfield[p_starting - 1 - (k - 1) * 2]; v_in := v_bench[k]; insert into public.match_events ( match_id, team_id, player_id, sub_in_player_id, event_type, minute) values (v_match, v_team_id, v_out, v_in, 'substitution', p_period + floor(random() * (p_period - 5))::int); end loop; end loop; -- Maçın adamı: kazanan takımın golcüsü; yoksa ev sahibinin 10'u. if v_motm is null then select stp.player_id into v_motm from public.season_team_players stp where stp.season_id = v_season and stp.team_id = v_home order by stp.id offset p_starting - 3 limit 1; v_motm_team := v_home; end if; insert into public.match_events (match_id, team_id, player_id, event_type, minute) values (v_match, v_motm_team, v_motm, 'man_of_the_match', 999); end if; end loop; -- Çember: ilk takım sabit, diğerleri bir adım döner. v_rot := array[v_rot[1]] || v_rot[p_per_group:p_per_group] || v_rot[2:p_per_group - 1]; end loop; end loop; -- Kart cezaları (tetikleyici "onay bekliyor" olarak açar): son oynanan -- haftadan öncekiler onaylanıp çekilmiş, son haftanın ilki onaylı ve -- sürüyor, kalanlar onay bekliyor. v_last_week_date := p_first_date + 7 * (p_played_weeks - 1); update public.player_penalties pp set status = 'approved', is_active = false, remaining_matches = 0, reviewed_at = now() from public.matches m where pp.match_id = m.id and pp.season_id = v_season and m.match_date < v_last_week_date; for v_rec in select pp.id, pp.match_count from public.player_penalties pp join public.matches m on m.id = pp.match_id where pp.season_id = v_season and m.match_date = v_last_week_date order by pp.created_at, pp.id loop if v_first_pen then update public.player_penalties set status = 'approved', is_active = true, remaining_matches = v_rec.match_count, reviewed_at = now() where id = v_rec.id; v_first_pen := false; end if; end loop; return v_season; end; $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_view_league(p_league_id uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_raw text; begin if p_league_id is null then return true; end if; -- Demo turnuva da diğerleri gibi: yalnız özellik açıksa ve gizliyse kısıtlı. if not public.private_leagues_enabled() then return true; end if; if not exists ( select 1 from public.leagues where id = p_league_id and is_private ) then return true; end if; if v_uid is null then return false; end if; if public.owns_league(p_league_id) or public.is_region_owner_of_league(p_league_id) then return true; end if; -- Kodla takip (kod hâlâ geçerliyse). if exists ( select 1 from public.league_followers f join public.leagues l on l.id = f.league_id where f.league_id = p_league_id and f.user_id = v_uid and lower(f.code) = lower(coalesce(l.access_code, '')) ) then return true; end if; -- Maç gözlemcisi. if exists ( select 1 from public.matches m where m.league_id = p_league_id and m.observer_id = v_uid ) then return true; end if; -- Takım sorumlusu (sezon bazında ya da takımın sorumlusu). if exists ( select 1 from public.team_managers tm join public.seasons s on s.id = tm.season_id where s.league_id = p_league_id and tm.user_id = v_uid ) or exists ( select 1 from public.season_teams st join public.seasons s on s.id = st.season_id join public.teams t on t.id = st.team_id where s.league_id = p_league_id and t.manager_id = v_uid ) then return true; end if; -- Turnuvadaki bir takımın aktif oyuncusu (hesap e-postası <telefon>@...). v_raw := split_part(coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'email', ''), '@', 1); return exists ( select 1 from public.season_team_players stp join public.seasons s on s.id = stp.season_id join public.players p on p.id = stp.player_id where s.league_id = p_league_id and coalesce(stp.is_active, true) and (p.auth_uid = v_uid or (v_raw <> '' and public.phone_raw10(p.phone) = v_raw)) ); end; $function$

create or replace function public.push_send(p_user_ids uuid[], p_title text, p_body text, p_url text DEFAULT '/'::text, p_tag text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_force boolean DEFAULT false) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare v_secret text; v_kind text := nullif(split_part(coalesce(p_tag, ''), '-', 1), ''); v_ref text := nullif(substr(coalesce(p_tag, ''), length(coalesce(v_kind, '')) + 2), ''); v_push uuid[]; v_url text; v_paused jsonb; v_match uuid; v_scorer uuid; begin if p_user_ids is null then return; end if; -- Demo turnuvalardan hiçbir kullanıcıya bildirim gitmez. if public.push_ref_is_demo(v_kind, v_ref) then return; end if; begin insert into public.notifications (user_id, title, body, kind, ref_id) select distinct u, p_title, p_body, v_kind, case when v_ref ~* '^[0-9a-f-]{36}$' then v_ref::uuid end from unnest(p_user_ids) u where u is not null and exists (select 1 from auth.users au where au.id = u); exception when others then raise warning 'push_send notifications: %', sqlerrm; end; -- Geçici olarak telefona gönderilmeyen türler (uygulamadaki listede -- kalır). app_settings.push_paused_kinds; ilk yarı sonucu 'halftime'. if not p_force then select value into v_paused from public.app_settings where key = 'push_paused_kinds'; if coalesce(v_paused, '[]'::jsonb) ? (case when v_kind = 'live' and p_title = 'İlk yarı sonucu' then 'halftime' else coalesce(v_kind, '') end) then return; end if; end if; -- Zorunlu bildirimde tür anahtarı atlanır; ana anahtar kapalıysa gitmez. select coalesce(array_agg(distinct u), '{}') into v_push from unnest(p_user_ids) u where u is not null and case when p_force then coalesce( (select np.push_enabled from public.notification_prefs np where np.user_id = u), true) else public.notif_wants(u, coalesce(v_kind, '')) end; -- Geçici kısıt: futbolcu/yönetici değilse yalnız Takip Listem'den. if not p_force and cardinality(v_push) > 0 and coalesce( (select value from public.app_settings where key = 'push_players_only'), 'false'::jsonb) = 'true'::jsonb then if v_ref ~* '^[0-9a-f-]{36}$' then v_match := v_ref::uuid; end if; begin v_scorer := nullif(current_setting('push.scorer', true), '')::uuid; exception when others then v_scorer := null; end; select coalesce(array_agg(u), '{}') into v_push from unnest(v_push) u where exists ( select 1 from public.season_team_players stp join public.players p on p.id = stp.player_id where stp.is_active and p.auth_uid = u) or exists (select 1 from public.admins a where a.user_id = u) or exists (select 1 from public.league_owners o where o.user_id = u) or exists (select 1 from public.region_owners r where r.user_id = u) or exists (select 1 from public.team_managers t where t.user_id = u) or (v_kind = 'result' and v_match is not null and exists ( select 1 from public.matches m where m.id = v_match and (exists (select 1 from public.user_follows uf where uf.user_id = u and uf.kind = 'team' and uf.target_id in (m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id)) or exists (select 1 from public.followed_teams f where f.user_id = u and f.team_id in (m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id))))) or (v_kind = 'goal' and v_scorer is not null and exists ( select 1 from public.user_follows uf where uf.user_id = u and uf.kind = 'player' and uf.target_id = v_scorer)); end if; if cardinality(v_push) = 0 or not exists ( select 1 from public.push_subscriptions where user_id = any (v_push) ) then return; end if; select value into v_secret from public.app_private_settings where key = 'push_secret'; if coalesce(v_secret, '') = '' then return; end if; -- Bildirime basınca ilgili ekran açılsın. v_url := case when p_tag is not null and coalesce(p_url, '/') = '/' then '/?n=' || p_tag else coalesce(p_url, '/') end; perform net.http_post( url := 'https://qxdjebzszikeslobrozf.supabase.co/functions/v1/send-push', body := jsonb_build_object( 'user_ids', to_jsonb(v_push), 'title', p_title, 'body', p_body, 'url', v_url, 'tag', p_tag ), headers := jsonb_build_object( 'Content-Type', 'application/json', 'x-push-secret', v_secret ) ); exception when others then raise warning 'push_send: %', sqlerrm; end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._otp_issue(p_raw text, p_kind text, p_title text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare v_provider text; v_code text; v_key text; v_hash text; v_sender text; v_template text; v_tur text; v_request bigint; v_id uuid; v_ip text; v_today int; begin if exists ( select 1 from public.sms_otp_codes where phone_raw10 = p_raw and created_at > now() - interval '60 seconds' ) then return 'too_soon'; end if; -- Aynı numaraya saatte en çok 3, günde en çok 5 kod. if (select count(*) from public.sms_otp_codes where phone_raw10 = p_raw and created_at > now() - interval '1 hour') >= 3 or (select count(*) from public.sms_otp_codes where phone_raw10 = p_raw and created_at > now() - interval '24 hours') >= 5 then return 'too_many'; end if; -- Gün içinde 10 yanlış kod girilen numara 24 saat kilitli. if (select coalesce(sum(attempts), 0) from public.sms_otp_codes where phone_raw10 = p_raw and created_at > now() - interval '24 hours') >= 10 then return 'too_many'; end if; -- Aynı bağlantıdan (IP) saatte en çok 10 farklı numara. v_ip := nullif(btrim(split_part( coalesce(current_setting('request.headers', true), '{}')::json ->> 'x-forwarded-for', ',', 1)), ''); if v_ip is not null and ( select count(distinct phone_raw10) from public.sms_otp_codes where client_ip = v_ip and phone_raw10 <> p_raw and created_at > now() - interval '1 hour') >= 10 then return 'too_many'; end if; -- Sistem geneli: günde en çok 300 kod; 240'ta (%80) adminlere uyarı. select count(*) into v_today from public.sms_otp_codes where created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'; if v_today >= 300 then return 'too_many'; end if; if v_today = 240 then perform public.telegram_notify( array(select user_id from public.admins where user_id is not null), '⚠️ Doğrulama kodu günlük sınırın %80''ine ulaştı (240 / 300). ' || 'Olağandışı bir yoğunluk ya da kötüye kullanım olabilir.' ); end if; select value #>> '{}' into v_provider from public.app_settings where key = 'sms_otp_provider'; v_provider := coalesce(v_provider, 'telegram'); v_code := lpad( ((('x' || encode(extensions.gen_random_bytes(4), 'hex'))::bit(32)::bigint) % 1000000)::text, 6, '0'); if v_provider = 'iletimerkezi' then select value into v_key from public.app_private_settings where key = 'iletimerkezi_key'; select value into v_hash from public.app_private_settings where key = 'iletimerkezi_hash'; select value into v_sender from public.app_private_settings where key = 'iletimerkezi_sender'; select value into v_template from public.app_private_settings where key = 'sms_otp_template'; v_tur := case when p_kind = 'password_change' then 'şifre değiştirme için' when p_title ilike 'Futbolcu%' then 'Futbolcu kaydınız için' when p_title ilike 'Turnuva sorumlusu%' then 'Sorumlu kaydınız için' when p_title ilike '%taraftar%' then 'Taraftar kaydınız için' else 'kaydınız için' end; v_template := coalesce(nullif(v_template, ''), 'Lig Masası {tur} doğrulama kodunuz: {kod}. Kodu kimseyle paylaşmayın.'); v_template := replace(v_template, '{tur}', v_tur); if coalesce(v_key, '') = '' or coalesce(v_hash, '') = '' or coalesce(v_sender, '') = '' then return 'not_configured'; end if; select net.http_post( url := 'https://api.iletimerkezi.com/v1/send-sms/json', body := jsonb_build_object('request', jsonb_build_object( 'authentication', jsonb_build_object('key', v_key, 'hash', v_hash), 'order', jsonb_build_object( 'sender', v_sender, 'sendDateTime', '', 'iys', '0', 'message', jsonb_build_object( 'text', replace(v_template, '{kod}', v_code), 'receipents', jsonb_build_object('number', jsonb_build_array(p_raw)) ) ) )), headers := '{"Content-Type": "application/json"}'::jsonb ) into v_request; end if; insert into public.sms_otp_codes ( phone_raw10, kind, code_hash, provider, request_id, expires_at, client_ip ) values ( p_raw, p_kind, extensions.crypt(v_code, extensions.gen_salt('bf')), v_provider, v_request, -- Elle iletilen kod için daha uzun süre. now() + case when v_provider = 'iletimerkezi' then interval '3 minutes' else interval '30 minutes' end, v_ip ) returning id into v_id; if v_provider <> 'iletimerkezi' then -- Test modu: kod adminlere gider, admin WhatsApp'tan iletir. Aynı -- numaranın önceki kodu için hatırlatma durur. update public.otp_telegram_reminders set done_at = now(), code = null where phone_raw10 = p_raw and done_at is null; insert into public.otp_telegram_reminders (otp_id, phone_raw10, title, code) values (v_id, p_raw, p_title, v_code); perform public.telegram_notify( array(select user_id from public.admins where user_id is not null), '📱 ' || p_title || E'\n' || public.format_phone_raw10(p_raw) || E'\nKod: ' || v_code, public._otp_telegram_buttons(v_id, p_raw, v_code) ); end if; return 'sent'; end; $function$

-- Takım sorumlusunun kadro talepleri (pending_actions) için tamamlayıcılar: -- * Forma numarası silinebilir (null): takım sorumlusu da yapabilir. -- * Aynı oyuncu için aynı türde ikinci bekleyen talep açılamaz. -- * Yeni talep onaylayıcılara (kurucu başkan + takımın bölge sorumlusu) -- bildirim olarak gider; sonuç talebi açana bildirilir. create or replace function public.set_jersey_number( p_season_id uuid, p_team_id uuid, p_player_id uuid, p_number integer ) returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$ begin if not (public.owns_season_team(p_season_id, p_team_id) or public.manages_team(p_season_id, p_team_id)) then raise exception 'Bu takımın forma numaralarını değiştirme yetkiniz yok.' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if p_number is not null and (p_number < 1 or p_number > 999) then raise exception 'Forma numarası 1 ile 999 arasında olmalı.'; end if; if p_number is not null and exists ( select 1 from public.season_team_players where season_id = p_season_id and team_id = p_team_id and jersey_number = p_number and is_active and player_id <> p_player_id ) then raise exception 'Bu forma numarası bu takımda zaten kullanılıyor.'; end if; update public.season_team_players set jersey_number = p_number where season_id = p_season_id and team_id = p_team_id and player_id = p_player_id and is_active; if not found then raise exception 'Futbolcu bu takımın kadrosunda bulunamadı.'; end if; end; $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_view_league(p_league_id uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_raw text; begin if p_league_id is null then return true; end if; -- Demo turnuva her zaman gizlidir; diğerleri özellik açıksa ve gizliyse. if not exists ( select 1 from public.leagues where id = p_league_id and is_demo ) then if not public.private_leagues_enabled() then return true; end if; if not exists ( select 1 from public.leagues where id = p_league_id and is_private ) then return true; end if; end if; if v_uid is null then return false; end if; if public.owns_league(p_league_id) or public.is_region_owner_of_league(p_league_id) then return true; end if; -- Kodla takip (kod hâlâ geçerliyse). if exists ( select 1 from public.league_followers f join public.leagues l on l.id = f.league_id where f.league_id = p_league_id and f.user_id = v_uid and lower(f.code) = lower(coalesce(l.access_code, '')) ) then return true; end if; -- Maç gözlemcisi. if exists ( select 1 from public.matches m where m.league_id = p_league_id and m.observer_id = v_uid ) then return true; end if; -- Takım sorumlusu (sezon bazında ya da takımın sorumlusu). if exists ( select 1 from public.team_managers tm join public.seasons s on s.id = tm.season_id where s.league_id = p_league_id and tm.user_id = v_uid ) or exists ( select 1 from public.season_teams st join public.seasons s on s.id = st.season_id join public.teams t on t.id = st.team_id where s.league_id = p_league_id and t.manager_id = v_uid ) then return true; end if; -- Turnuvadaki bir takımın aktif oyuncusu (hesap e-postası <telefon>@...). v_raw := split_part(coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'email', ''), '@', 1); return exists ( select 1 from public.season_team_players stp join public.seasons s on s.id = stp.season_id join public.players p on p.id = stp.player_id where s.league_id = p_league_id and coalesce(stp.is_active, true) and (p.auth_uid = v_uid or (v_raw <> '' and public.phone_raw10(p.phone) = v_raw)) ); end; $function$

' || left(p_message, 400) ); exception when others then raise warning 'log_client_error telegram: %', sqlerrm; end; end if; end; $$

( select mm.player_id as pid, sum(coalesce((v_rules -> 'moments' ->> mm.kind)::numeric, case mm.kind when 'save' then 0.3 when 'one_on_one' then 0.5 when 'pen_save' then 1.0 when 'gk_error' then -0.5 when 'tackle' then 0.3 when 'line_clear' then 0.5 when 'interception' then 0.2 when 'pen_conceded' then -0.5 when 'key_pass' then 0.3 when 'recovery' then 0.2 when 'woodwork' then 0.2 when 'bad_loss' then -0.5 when 'pen_won' then 0.5 when 'big_miss' then -0.3 when 'pen_miss' then -1.0 when 'error_goal' then -1.0 else 0 end)) as pts from public.match_moments mm where mm.match_id = p_match group by 1 ), base as ( select ro.player_id, ro.team_id, ro.starter, ro.ord, (ro.team_id = m.home_team_id) as home, case when ro.starter and gk.player_id = ro.player_id then 0 when ro.pline = 0 then 1 else ro.pline end as line, coalesce(ev.goals, 0) as goals, coalesce(ev.pens, 0) as pens, coalesce(ev.owns, 0) as owns, coalesce(asg.assists, 0) as assists, coalesce(ev.yellows, 0) as yellows, coalesce(ev.reds, 0) as reds, ev.red_min, coalesce(ev.subbed_out, false) as subbed_out, ev.out_min, coalesce(ev.motm, false) as motm, sin.pid is not null as subbed_in, sin.in_min, coalesce(mo.pts, 0) = ro.player_id ), played as ( select b.*, greatest(0, least(case when b.subbed_out then coalesce(b.out_min, v_end) else v_end end, case when b.reds > 0 then coalesce(b.red_min, v_end) else v_end end) - case when b.starter then 0 else coalesce(b.in_min, v_end) end) as mins from base b where b.starter or b.subbed_in ) select pl.player_id, pl.team_id, pl.home, pl.ord::int, pl.line::int, pl.starter, pl.mins::int, (pl.goals + pl.pens)::int, pl.assists::int, pl.yellows::int, pl.reds::int, (case when pl.home then m.away_score else m.home_score end)::int, round(least(10, greatest(3, case when pl.starter then (r.j->>'base')::numeric else (r.j->>'sub_base')::numeric end + (r.j->>'goal')::numeric * pl.goals + (r.j->>'pen_goal')::numeric * pl.pens + (r.j->>'assist')::numeric * pl.assists + (r.j->>'own_goal')::numeric * pl.owns + case when pl.motm then (r.j->>'motm')::numeric else 0 end + case when pl.reds > 0 and pl.yellows > 0 then (r.j->>'second_yellow')::numeric + (r.j->>'yellow')::numeric * (pl.yellows - 1) else (r.j->>'yellow')::numeric * pl.yellows + (r.j->>'red')::numeric * pl.reds end + case when pl.mins >= 60 then (r.j->>'full_bonus')::numeric else 0 end + case when (case when pl.home then m.home_score else m.away_score end) > (case when pl.home then m.away_score else m.home_score end) then (r.j->>'win')::numeric when (case when pl.home then m.home_score else m.away_score end) < (case when pl.home then m.away_score else m.home_score end) then (r.j->>'loss')::numeric else 0 end + case when (case when pl.home then m.away_score else m.home_score end) = 0 and pl.mins >= (r.j->>'cs_minutes')::numeric then case pl.line when 0 then (r.j->>'cs_gk')::numeric when 1 then (r.j->>'cs_def')::numeric else 0 end else 0 end + pl.moments)), 1) from played pl, r where pl.mins >= (r.j->>'min_minutes')::numeric; end; $$

create or replace function public.identity_add_to_roster( p_match_id uuid, p_team_id uuid, p_first text, p_last text, p_birth date, p_tc text, p_player_id uuid default null, p_jersey smallint default null, p_display text default null ) returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path to '' as $function$ declare m public.matches; v_staff boolean; v_hash text; v_player uuid := p_player_id; v_first text := initcap(lower(trim(p_first))); v_last text := initcap(lower(trim(p_last))); v_disp text[]; v_cur public.season_team_players; v_name text; begin perform public._identity_guard(p_tc); select * into m from public.matches where id = p_match_id; if not found then raise exception 'Maç bulunamadı.'; end if; if p_team_id not in (m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id) then raise exception 'Takım bu maçta değil.'; end if; v_staff := public.owns_season_team(m.season_id, p_team_id); if not v_staff and not public.attendance_is_manager(m.season_id, p_team_id) then raise exception 'Bu takıma oyuncu ekleme yetkiniz yok.'; end if; v_hash := public._identity_hash(p_tc); if v_player is not null then -- Seçilen mevcut profil kimlikle onaylanır (kurallar identity_verify'da). perform public.identity_verify(v_player, p_first, p_last, p_birth, p_tc); else select player_id into v_player from public.player_verifications where tc_hash = v_hash; if v_player is null then -- Çip adı Türkçe harf taşımaz; kağıttaki yazım aynı harflerse o kullanılır. v_disp := regexp_split_to_array(trim(coalesce(p_display, '')), '\s+'); if array_length(v_disp, 1) >= 2 and public._id_fold(array_to_string(v_disp[1:array_length(v_disp, 1) - 1], ' ')) = public._id_fold(trim(p_first)) and public._id_fold(v_disp[array_length(v_disp, 1)]) = public._id_fold(trim(p_last)) then v_first := array_to_string(v_disp[1:array_length(v_disp, 1) - 1], ' '); v_last := v_disp[array_length(v_disp, 1)]; end if; insert into public.players (name, surname, birth_date) values (v_first, v_last, p_birth) returning id into v_player; insert into public.player_verifications (player_id, tc_hash, verified_by) values (v_player, v_hash, auth.uid()); insert into public.identity_events (player_id, action, user_id) values (v_player, 'create', auth.uid()), (v_player, 'verify', auth.uid()); end if; end if; select trim(coalesce(name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(surname, '')) into v_name from public.players where id = v_player; select * into v_cur from public.season_team_players where season_id = m.season_id and player_id = v_player order by is_active desc limit 1; if found and v_cur.is_active and v_cur.team_id <> p_team_id then raise exception '% bu sezon başka bir takımda kayıtlı.', v_name; end if; if found and v_cur.is_active then return jsonb_build_object('status', 'added', 'player_id', v_player, 'name', v_name); end if; if v_staff then if found then update public.season_team_players set team_id = p_team_id, is_active = true, jersey_number = coalesce(p_jersey, jersey_number) where id = v_cur.id; else insert into public.season_team_players (season_id, team_id, player_id, jersey_number, is_active) values (m.season_id, p_team_id, v_player, p_jersey, true); end if; return jsonb_build_object('status', 'added', 'player_id', v_player, 'name', v_name); end if; insert into public.pending_actions (action_type, season_id, team_id, payload) values ('roster_add', m.season_id, p_team_id, jsonb_build_object( 'player_id', v_player, 'player_name', v_name, 'match_id', p_match_id, 'jersey_number', p_jersey, 'via', 'identity')) on conflict do nothing; return jsonb_build_object('status', 'pending', 'player_id', v_player, 'name', v_name); end; $function$

create function pg_temp.demo_finish(p_stage int, p_slot int, hs int, aw int, hp int, ap int, p_date date, p_time text) returns void language plpgsql as $$ declare m public.matches; side int; t uuid; n int; i int; scorer uuid; helper uuid; used int[] := '{}'; mn int; kicks jsonb := '[]'; k int; top uuid; begin select * into m from public.matches where cup_bracket_id = current_setting('demo.bracket')::uuid and cup_stage = p_stage and cup_slot = p_slot; if not found then raise exception 'maç yok: % %', p_stage, p_slot; end if; update public.matches set match_date = p_date, match_time = p_time, pitch_id = '114e5e54-cf08-44af-a97e-7c911c6641f9', home_formation = '2-3-1', away_formation = '2-3-1' where id = m.id; for side in 0..1 loop t := case side when 0 then m.home_team_id else m.away_team_id end; -- Takımın son lig maçındaki kadro. insert into public.match_rosters (match_id, team_id, player_id, is_starting, jersey_number, pos_x, pos_y, season_id, is_home, league_id, is_captain) select m.id, t, r.player_id, r.is_starting, r.jersey_number, r.pos_x, r.pos_y, m.season_id, side = 0, m.league_id, r.is_captain from public.match_rosters r where r.team_id = t and r.match_id = (select x.id from public.matches x where x.season_id = m.season_id and x.tiebreak is null and t in (x.home_team_id, x.away_team_id) order by x.week desc limit 1); n := case side when 0 then hs else aw end; for i in 1..n loop select player_id into scorer from public.match_rosters where match_id = m.id and team_id = t and is_starting and coalesce(pos_x, 1) <> 0 order by random() limit 1; helper := null; if random() < 0.65 then select player_id into helper from public.match_rosters where match_id = m.id and team_id = t and is_starting and coalesce(pos_x, 1) <> 0 and player_id <> scorer order by random() limit 1; end if; loop mn := 2 + floor(random() * 46)::int; exit when not mn = any(used); end loop; used := used || mn; insert into public.match_events (match_id, team_id, player_id, event_type, minute, season_id, assist_player_id, is_own_goal, is_penalty) values (m.id, t, scorer, 'goal', mn, m.season_id, helper, false, false); end loop; -- Bir oyuncu değişikliği. insert into public.match_events (match_id, team_id, player_id, event_type, minute, season_id, sub_in_player_id) select m.id, t, (select player_id from public.match_rosters where match_id = m.id and team_id = t and is_starting and coalesce(pos_x, 1) <> 0 order by random() limit 1), 'substitution', 30 + floor(random() * 10)::int, m.season_id, (select player_id from public.match_rosters where match_id = m.id and team_id = t and not is_starting order by random() limit 1); end loop; -- Penaltılar: sırayla, ilk 5 atışta belirlenen skor. if hp is not null then declare hg int := 0; ag int := 0; hk int := 0; ak int := 0; begin for k in 1..5 loop hk := hk + 1; if k <= hp then hg := hg + 1; end if; kicks := kicks || jsonb_build_object('t', 'h', 'g', k <= hp); exit when hg > ag + (5 - ak) or ag > hg + (5 - hk); ak := ak + 1; if k <= ap then ag := ag + 1; end if; kicks := kicks || jsonb_build_object('t', 'a', 'g', k <= ap); exit when hg > ag + (5 - ak) or ag > hg + (5 - hk); end loop; end; end if; update public.matches set status = 'finished', is_completed = true, home_score = hs, away_score = aw, home_pens = hp, away_pens = ap, shootout = case when hp is null then null else kicks end where id = m.id; -- Maçın adamı: kazanan taraftan en çok gol atan. select e.player_id into top from public.match_events e where e.match_id = m.id and e.event_type = 'goal' and e.team_id = public.cup_match_side((select x from public.matches x where x.id = m.id), false) group by e.player_id order by count(*) desc, random() limit 1; if top is not null then insert into public.match_events (match_id, team_id, player_id, event_type, minute, season_id) select m.id, public.cup_match_side(x, false), top, 'man_of_the_match', 999, m.season_id from public.matches x where x.id = m.id; end if; end; $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.register_player_manual(p_phone text, p_code text, p_password text, p_first text, p_last text, p_birth date, p_tc text, p_main text, p_sub text, p_foot text, p_height integer, p_weight integer) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare v_raw text := public.phone_raw10(p_phone); v_first text := coalesce(public.tr_name_fix(p_first), ''); v_last text := coalesce(public.tr_name_fix(p_last), ''); v_hash text; v_player uuid; v_auth uuid; v_count int; v_uid uuid; v_res text; v_phone_owner uuid; v_new_first text; v_new_last text; v_new_birth date; begin if not public.self_registration_enabled() or not public.ibraz_flag('ibraz_enabled') then return 'disabled'; end if; if v_raw is null or v_raw !~ '^5[0-9]{9}$' then return 'invalid_phone'; end if; if not public.tc_valid(p_tc) then return 'invalid_tc'; end if; if length(v_first) < 2 or length(v_last) < 2 or p_birth is null or p_birth < date '1940-01-01' or p_birth > (current_date - interval '10 years')::date or coalesce(p_main, '') not in ('Kaleci', 'Defans', 'Orta Saha', 'Forvet') or (p_sub is not null and p_sub not in ('Stoper', 'Sol Bek', 'Sağ Bek', 'Defansif', 'Merkez', 'Ofansif', 'Sol Kanat', 'Sağ Kanat', 'Santrfor', 'Sol Kanat Forvet', 'Sağ Kanat Forvet')) or (p_foot is not null and p_foot not in ('Sağ', 'Sol', 'Her İkisi')) or (p_height is not null and p_height not between 120 and 230) or (p_weight is not null and p_weight not between 35 and 200) then return 'invalid_data'; end if; if p_password is null or length(p_password) not between 6 and 10 or p_password !~ '[^A-Za-z]' then return 'weak_password'; end if; if exists (select 1 from auth.users where email = v_raw || '@masterclass.com') then return 'has_account'; end if; v_hash := public._identity_hash(p_tc); -- Bu TC zaten onaylı bir profilde: okutarak (çip) kayıt olmalı. if exists (select 1 from public.player_verifications v where v.tc_hash = v_hash) then return 'tc_taken'; end if; if exists (select 1 from public.identity_pending ip where ip.tc_plain = p_tc) then return 'tc_pending'; end if; -- Aynı kişi: önce TC onayı, sonra numarası (kodla doğrulanır) kayıtlı -- profil, yoksa ad + soyad + doğum tarihi tutan onaysız profil. if v_player is null then select p.id into v_phone_owner from public.players p where p.phone = v_raw; if v_phone_owner is not null then -- Başka bir kimlikle onaylı ya da hesabı olan profil: numara başkasının. if exists (select 1 from public.player_verifications v where v.player_id = v_phone_owner) or exists (select 1 from public.players p where p.id = v_phone_owner and p.auth_uid is not null) then return 'phone_taken'; end if; v_player := v_phone_owner; end if; end if; if v_player is null then select count(*), min(p.id::text)::uuid into v_count, v_player from public.players p where (p.birth_date = p_birth -- Yalnız yılı bilinen profil (01.01): aynı yıl yeter. or (to_char(p.birth_date, 'MM-DD') = '01-01' and extract(year from p.birth_date) = extract(year from p_birth))) and (' ' || public._id_fold(v_last) || ' ' like '% ' || public._id_fold(p.surname) || ' %' or ' ' || public._id_fold(p.surname) || ' ' like '% ' || public._id_fold(v_last) || ' %') and (' ' || public._id_fold(v_first) || ' ' like '% ' || public._id_fold(p.name) || ' %' or ' ' || public._id_fold(p.name) || ' ' like '% ' || public._id_fold(v_first) || ' %') and not exists (select 1 from public.player_verifications v where v.player_id = p.id); if v_count > 1 then return 'ambiguous'; end if; if v_player is not null then select auth_uid into v_auth from public.players where id = v_player; end if; end if; if v_auth is not null then return 'profile_has_account'; end if; -- Kimlikle bulunan profil başka, numara başka bir profilde: numara -- başkasının. select p.id into v_phone_owner from public.players p where p.phone = v_raw; if v_phone_owner is not null and v_phone_owner is distinct from v_player then return 'phone_taken'; end if; v_res := public._otp_consume(v_raw, p_code); if v_res <> 'ok' then return v_res; end if; if v_player is null then insert into public.players ( name, surname, birth_date, phone, main_position, sub_position, preferred_foot, height, weight ) values ( v_first, v_last, p_birth, v_raw, p_main, p_sub, p_foot, p_height, p_weight ) returning id into v_player; else -- Mevcut (onaysız) profil: ad, soyad, doğum tarihi olduğu gibi kalır; -- onay sırasında yetkili kimlikle karşılaştırıp düzeltir. update public.players set phone = v_raw, main_position = p_main, sub_position = case when p_main = 'Kaleci' then null else coalesce(p_sub, sub_position) end, preferred_foot = coalesce(p_foot, preferred_foot), height = coalesce(p_height, height), weight = coalesce(p_weight, weight) where id = v_player; end if; v_uid := public.set_phone_account_password( v_raw, p_password, false, v_first || ' ' || v_last); -- Hesap açılırken aynı numaralı başka bir kayıt bağlandıysa düzeltilir. update public.players set auth_uid = null where auth_uid = v_uid and id <> v_player; update public.players set auth_uid = v_uid where id = v_player; -- Onaysız: TC yalnız onay bekleme süresince açık tutulur (onay/ret'te silinir). insert into public.identity_pending (player_id, tc_plain) values (v_player, p_tc) on conflict (player_id) do update set tc_plain = excluded.tc_plain, requested_at = now(); insert into public.identity_events (player_id, action, user_id) values (v_player, 'register_ibraz', v_uid); return 'ok'; end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.license_list(p_filter jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_q text DEFAULT ''::text, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_admin boolean := public.is_admin(); v_roster text := coalesce(p_filter->>'roster', 'in'); v_staff boolean := false; v_league text := coalesce(p_filter->>'league', 'all'); v_profile text := coalesce(p_filter->>'profile', 'all'); v_account text := coalesce(p_filter->>'account', 'all'); v_kvkk text := coalesce(p_filter->>'kvkk', 'all'); v_q text := public.tr_fold(trim(coalesce(p_q, ''))); v_out jsonb; begin if v_uid is null then return jsonb_build_object('total', 0, 'rows', '[]'::jsonb); end if; -- Kurucu başkan / bölge sorumlusu: kendi kadroları + boştaki oyuncular -- (hiçbir etkin kadroda olmayan; başka turnuvadan gelebilecek). v_staff := exists (select 1 from public.league_owners where user_id = v_uid) or exists (select 1 from public.region_owners where user_id = v_uid); with act as ( select s.id as season_id, l.id as league_id from public.seasons s join public.leagues l on l.id = s.league_id where s.deleted_at is null and coalesce(l.status, '') <> 'passive' and l.is_active is not false ), roster as ( select stp.player_id, act.league_id, st.group_id from public.season_team_players stp join act on act.season_id = stp.season_id left join public.season_teams st on st.season_id = stp.season_id and st.team_id = stp.team_id where stp.player_id is not null and stp.is_active is not false ), vis as ( select r.* from roster r where v_admin or exists (select 1 from public.league_owners lo where lo.league_id = r.league_id and lo.user_id = v_uid) or exists (select 1 from public.groups g join public.region_owners ro on ro.region_id = g.region_id where g.id = r.group_id and ro.user_id = v_uid) ), kv as ( select x.player_id, public.player_consent_complete(x.player_id) as complete from (select distinct c.player_id from public.player_consents c) x ), base as ( select p.id, p.name, p.surname, p.birth_date, p.preferred_foot, p.main_position, p.sub_position, p.photo_url, case when v_admin or exists (select 1 from vis v where v.player_id = p.id) then p.phone end as phone, p.height, p.weight, p.created_at, p.updated_at, exists (select 1 from roster r where r.player_id = p.id) as in_roster, coalesce((select array_agg(distinct v.league_id) from vis v where v.player_id = p.id), '{}') as leagues, exists (select 1 from public.player_verifications pv where pv.player_id = p.id) as verified, p.auth_uid is not null as has_account, coalesce(kv.complete, false) as kvkk, public.tr_fold(concat_ws(' ', p.name, p.surname)) as folded from public.players p left join kv on kv.player_id = p.id where v_admin or exists (select 1 from vis v where v.player_id = p.id) or (v_staff and not exists (select 1 from roster r where r.player_id = p.id)) ), f as ( select b.*, (v_roster = 'all' or (v_roster = 'in') = b.in_roster) as pr, (v_league = 'all' or v_league = any (b.leagues::text[])) as pl, (v_profile = 'all' or (v_profile = 'ver') = b.verified) as pp, (v_account = 'all' or (v_account = 'yes') = b.has_account) as pa, (v_kvkk = 'all' or (v_kvkk = 'ok') = b.kvkk) as pk, (v_q = '' or strpos(b.folded, v_q) > 0) as pq from base b ) select jsonb_build_object( 'total', (select count(*) from f where pr and pl and pp and pa and pk and pq), 'rows', coalesce(( select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) - 'folded' - 'pr' - 'pl' - 'pp' - 'pa' - 'pk' - 'pq' order by x.folded) from (select * from f where pr and pl and pp and pa and pk and pq order by folded offset greatest(p_offset, 0) limit least(greatest(p_limit, 0), 200)) x), '[]'::jsonb), 'banner', (select jsonb_build_object( 'missing', count(*) filter (where not kvkk), 'no_account', count(*) filter (where not kvkk and not has_account)) from base where in_roster), 'leagues', coalesce(( select jsonb_object_agg(l.id, l.name) from public.leagues l where l.id in (select distinct league_id from vis)), '{}'::jsonb), 'facets', jsonb_build_object( 'roster', (select jsonb_build_object( 'in', count(*) filter (where in_roster), 'free', count(*) filter (where not in_roster), 'all', count(*)) from f where pl and pp and pa and pk and pq), 'league', coalesce(( select jsonb_object_agg(k, n) from ( select 'all' as k, count(*) as n from f where pr and pp and pa and pk and pq union all select lid::text, count(*) from f, unnest(f.leagues) lid where pr and pp and pa and pk and pq group by lid) z), '{}'::jsonb), 'profile', (select jsonb_build_object( 'all', count(*), 'ver', count(*) filter (where verified), 'unv', count(*) filter (where not verified)) from f where pr and pl and pa and pk and pq), 'account', (select jsonb_build_object( 'all', count(*), 'yes', count(*) filter (where has_account), 'no', count(*) filter (where not has_account)) from f where pr and pl Turnuva satırı Turnuva -- Yönetimi'nde görünür, aktife alınınca her şey geri gelir. if coalesce(v_passive, false) then return false; end if; -- Demo turnuva da diğerleri gibi: yalnız özellik açıksa ve gizliyse kısıtlı. if not public.private_leagues_enabled() then return true; end if; if not coalesce(v_private, false) then return true; end if; if v_uid is null then return false; end if; if public.owns_league(p_league_id) or public.is_region_owner_of_league(p_league_id) then return true; end if; -- Kodla takip (kod hâlâ geçerliyse). if exists ( select 1 from public.league_followers f join public.leagues l on l.id = f.league_id where f.league_id = p_league_id and f.user_id = v_uid and lower(f.code) = lower(coalesce(l.access_code, '')) ) then return true; end if; -- Maç gözlemcisi. if exists ( select 1 from public.matches m where m.league_id = p_league_id and m.observer_id = v_uid ) then return true; end if; -- Takım sorumlusu (sezon bazında ya da takımın sorumlusu). if exists ( select 1 from public.team_managers tm join public.seasons s on s.id = tm.season_id where s.league_id = p_league_id and tm.user_id = v_uid ) or exists ( select 1 from public.season_teams st join public.seasons s on s.id = st.season_id join public.teams t on t.id = st.team_id where s.league_id = p_league_id and t.manager_id = v_uid ) then return true; end if; -- Turnuvadaki bir takımın aktif oyuncusu (hesap e-postası <telefon>@...). v_raw := split_part(coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'email', ''), '@', 1); return exists ( select 1 from public.season_team_players stp join public.seasons s on s.id = stp.season_id join public.players p on p.id = stp.player_id where s.league_id = p_league_id and coalesce(stp.is_active, true) and (p.auth_uid = v_uid or (v_raw <> '' and public.phone_raw10(p.phone) = v_raw)) ); end; $function$

-- If the following are true: -- * the extension to be created is a TLE -- * the extension is created with `cascade` -- -- then we pre-`create` all nested extension dependencies which are part of -- `supautils.privileged_extensions`. This is because supautils can't intercept -- the extension creation for dependencies - it can only intercept the `create -- extension` statement. do $$ declare _extname text := 'pg_net'; _extschema text := null; _extversion text := null; _extcascade bool := false; _r record; begin if not _extcascade then return; end if; if not exists (select from pg_extension where extname = 'pg_tle') then return; end if; if not exists (select from pgtle.available_extensions() where name = _extname) then return; end if; if _extversion is null then select default_version from pgtle.available_extensions() where name = _extname into _extversion; end if; if _extschema is null then select schema from pgtle.available_extension_versions() where name = _extname and version = _extversion into _extschema; end if; for _r in ( with recursive available_extensions(name, default_version) as ( select name, default_version from pg_available_extensions union select name, default_version from pgtle.available_extensions() ) , available_extension_versions(name, version, requires) as ( select name, version, requires from pg_available_extension_versions union select name, version, requires from pgtle.available_extension_versions() ) , all_dependencies(name, dependency) as ( select e.name, unnest(ev.requires) as dependency from available_extensions e join available_extension_versions ev on ev.name = e.name and ev.version = e.default_version ) , dependencies(name) AS ( select unnest(requires) from available_extension_versions where name = _extname and version = _extversion union select all_dependencies.dependency from all_dependencies join dependencies d on d.name = all_dependencies.name ) select name from dependencies intersect select name from regexp_split_to_table(current_setting('supautils.privileged_extensions', true), '\s*,\s*') as t(name) ) loop if _extschema is null then execute(format('create extension if not exists %I cascade', _r.name)); CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.register_player(p_phone text, p_code text, p_password text, p_first text, p_last text, p_birth date, p_tc text, p_main text, p_sub text, p_foot text, p_height integer, p_weight integer) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare v_raw text := public.phone_raw10(p_phone); v_first text := btrim(coalesce(p_first, '')); v_last text := btrim(coalesce(p_last, '')); v_hash text; v_player uuid; v_auth uuid; v_count int; v_uid uuid; v_res text; v_phone_owner uuid; begin if not public.self_registration_enabled() then return 'disabled'; end if; if v_raw is null or v_raw !~ '^5[0-9]{9}$' then return 'invalid_phone'; end if; if not public.tc_valid(p_tc) then return 'invalid_tc'; end if; if length(v_first) < 2 or length(v_last) < 2 or p_birth is null or p_birth < date '1940-01-01' or p_birth > (current_date - interval '10 years')::date or coalesce(p_main, '') not in ('Kaleci', 'Defans', 'Orta Saha', 'Forvet') or (p_sub is not null and p_sub not in ('Stoper', 'Sol Bek', 'Sağ Bek', 'Defansif', 'Merkez', 'Ofansif', 'Sol Kanat', 'Sağ Kanat', 'Santrfor', 'Sol Kanat Forvet', 'Sağ Kanat Forvet')) or (p_foot is not null and p_foot not in ('Sağ', 'Sol', 'Her İkisi')) or (p_height is not null and p_height not between 120 and 230) or (p_weight is not null and p_weight not between 35 and 200) then return 'invalid_data'; end if; if p_password is null or length(p_password) not between 6 and 10 or p_password !~ '[^A-Za-z]' then return 'weak_password'; end if; if exists (select 1 from auth.users where email = v_raw || '@masterclass.com') then return 'has_account'; end if; v_hash := public._identity_hash(p_tc); -- Aynı kişi: önce TC onayı, yoksa ad + soyad + doğum tarihi tutan -- onaysız profil. select v.player_id, p.auth_uid into v_player, v_auth from public.player_verifications v join public.players p on p.id = v.player_id where v.tc_hash = v_hash; if v_player is null then select count(*), min(p.id::text)::uuid into v_count, v_player from public.players p where (p.birth_date = p_birth -- Yalnız yılı bilinen profil (01.01): aynı yıl yeter. or (to_char(p.birth_date, 'MM-DD') = '01-01' and extract(year from p.birth_date) = extract(year from p_birth))) and public.tr_fold(p.surname) = public.tr_fold(v_last) and (public.tr_fold(p.name) = public.tr_fold(v_first) or public.tr_fold(v_first) like public.tr_fold(p.name) || ' %' or public.tr_fold(p.name) like public.tr_fold(v_first) || ' %') and not exists (select 1 from public.player_verifications v where v.player_id = p.id); if v_count > 1 then return 'ambiguous'; end if; if v_player is not null then select auth_uid into v_auth from public.players where id = v_player; end if; end if; if v_auth is not null then return 'profile_has_account'; end if; -- Numara başka bir profilde kayıtlıysa: ad soyad tutan onaysız profil -- o kişidir (bağlanır); tutmuyorsa numara başkasınındır. select p.id into v_phone_owner from public.players p where p.phone = v_raw; if v_phone_owner is not null and v_phone_owner is distinct from v_player then if v_player is null and exists ( select 1 from public.players p where p.id = v_phone_owner and p.auth_uid is null and public.tr_fold(p.surname) = public.tr_fold(v_last) and (public.tr_fold(p.name) = public.tr_fold(v_first) or public.tr_fold(v_first) like public.tr_fold(p.name) || ' %' or public.tr_fold(p.name) like public.tr_fold(v_first) || ' %') and not exists (select 1 from public.player_verifications v where v.player_id = p.id) ) then v_player := v_phone_owner; else return 'phone_taken'; end if; end if; v_res := public._otp_consume(v_raw, p_code); if v_res <> 'ok' then return v_res; end if; if v_player is null then insert into public.players ( name, surname, birth_date, phone, main_position, sub_position, preferred_foot, height, weight ) values ( v_first, v_last, p_birth, v_raw, p_main, p_sub, p_foot, p_height, p_weight ) returning id into v_player; else -- Mevcut profil: kişinin kendi girdikleri yazılır; ad profildeki gibi -- kalır, doğum tarihi yalnız yıl biliniyorsa kimliktekiyle düzelir. update public.players set phone = v_raw, -- Yalnız yılı bilinen doğum tarihi kimlikteki tarihle düzelir. birth_date = case when to_char(birth_date, 'MM-DD') = '01-01' and extract(year from birth_date) = extract(year from p_birth) then p_birth else birth_date end, main_position = p_main, sub_position = case when p_main = 'Kaleci' then null else coalesce(p_sub, sub_position) end, preferred_foot = coalesce(p_foot, preferred_foot), height = coalesce(p_height, height), weight = coalesce(p_weight, weight) where id = v_player; end if; v_uid := public.set_phone_account_password( v_raw, p_password, false, v_first || ' ' || v_last); -- Hesap açılırken aynı numaralı başka bir kayıt bağlandıysa düzeltilir. update public.players set auth_uid = null where auth_uid = v_uid and id <> v_player; update public.players set auth_uid = v_uid where id = v_player; insert into public.player_verifications (player_id, tc_hash, verified_by) values (v_player, v_hash, v_uid) on conflict (player_id) do nothing; insert into public.identity_events (player_id, action, user_id) values (v_player, 'register', v_uid); return 'ok'; end; $function$

create or replace function public.tournament_offer_respond( p_token text, p_version int, p_response text, p_reason text, p_note text, p_consents jsonb default null ) returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path to '' as $function$ declare r public.tournament_requests; o public.tournament_offers; v_note text := nullif(left(btrim(coalesce(p_note, '')), 1000), ''); v_reason text := nullif(left(btrim(coalesce(p_reason, '')), 60), ''); v_label text; v_headers json; v_consents jsonb; begin if coalesce(p_token, '') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$' then raise exception 'Bağlantı geçersiz.'; end if; if p_response not in ('accepted', 'revision', 'rejected') then raise exception 'Geçersiz cevap.'; end if; select * into r from public.tournament_requests where offer_token = p_token for update; if not found then raise exception 'Teklif bulunamadı.'; end if; if r.league_id is not null or r.status = 'cancelled' then raise exception 'Bu teklif kapandı; sorularınız için WhatsApp''tan yazın.'; end if; select * into o from public.tournament_offers where request_id = r.id order by version desc limit 1; if not found or o.version <> p_version then raise exception 'Teklif güncellendi; sayfayı yenileyip son teklifi görün.'; end if; -- Kabulde üç ayrı onay zorunlu: ön bilgilendirme + mesafeli satış, -- kullanım koşulları + KVKK beyanı, aydınlatma metni. if p_response = 'accepted' and not ( coalesce((p_consents ->> 'pre_info')::boolean, false) and coalesce((p_consents ->> 'terms')::boolean, false) and coalesce((p_consents ->> 'privacy')::boolean, false)) then raise exception 'Kabul için üç onay kutusunu da işaretlemeniz gerekiyor.'; end if; if p_response = 'accepted' then begin v_headers := current_setting('request.headers', true)::json; exception when others then v_headers := null; end; v_consents := jsonb_build_object( 'pre_info', true, 'terms', true, 'privacy', true, 'doc_version', left(coalesce(p_consents ->> 'doc_version', ''), 40), 'at', now(), 'ip', split_part(coalesce(v_headers ->> 'x-forwarded-for', ''), ',', 1), 'user_agent', left(coalesce(v_headers ->> 'user-agent', ''), 300) ); end if; if p_response = 'revision' and v_note is null then raise exception 'Revize isteğinizi yazın.'; end if; -- Aynı cevabı tekrar göndermek bildirim üretmez. if p_response <> 'accepted' and o.response is not distinct from p_response and o.response_note is not distinct from v_note and o.response_reason is not distinct from v_reason then return jsonb_build_object('response', o.response, 'responded_at', o.responded_at); end if; update public.tournament_offers set response = p_response, response_reason = v_reason, response_note = v_note, responded_at = now(), terms_accepted_at = case when p_response = 'accepted' then now() else null end, consents = v_consents where id = o.id returning * into o; update public.tournament_requests set offer_response = p_response, offer_responded_at = now(), status = case p_response when 'accepted' then 'won' when 'rejected' then 'lost' else 'offered' end where id = r.id; v_label := case p_response when 'accepted' then '✅ Teklif kabul edildi' when 'revision' then '✏️ Revize istendi' else '❌ Teklif reddedildi' end; begin perform public.telegram_notify( array(select user_id from public.admins where user_id is not null), v_label || ' · ' || r.code || case when o.version > 1 then ' (revize ' || (o.version - 1) || ')' else '' end || E'
' || r.contact_name || ' · ' || r.phone || coalesce(E'
Sebep: ' || v_reason, '') || coalesce(E'
Not: ' || v_note, '') ); exception when others then raise warning 'tournament_offer_respond telegram: %', sqlerrm; end; return jsonb_build_object('response', o.response, 'responded_at', o.responded_at); end; $function$

' || left(p_message, 400) ); exception when others then raise warning 'log_client_error telegram: %', sqlerrm; end; end if; end; $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tr_name_word_fix(p_word text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare w text := btrim(coalesce(p_word, '')); f text; best text; low text; vowels text; i int; c text; begin if w = '' or w ~ '[çğöşüÇĞÖŞÜ]' or w !~ '^[A-Za-zıİ]+$' then return w; end if; f := public._id_fold(w); -- Sözlük: oyuncu ad ve soyadlarındaki kelimeler (en sık yazım). select t.word into best from ( select regexp_split_to_table(btrim(p.name), '\s+') as word from public.players p union all select regexp_split_to_table(btrim(p.surname), '\s+') from public.players p ) t where public._id_fold(t.word) = f and t.word ~ '^[A-ZÇĞİÖŞÜ][a-zçğıöşü]+$' group by t.word order by (t.word ~ '[çğöşüıiÇĞÖŞÜİ]') desc, count(*) desc, t.word limit 1; if best is not null then return best; end if; -- Sözlükte yok: Türkçe küçük harf, ı/i ünlü uyumuyla. low := replace(replace(w, 'I', 'ı'), 'İ', 'i'); low := lower(low); vowels := regexp_replace(low, '[^aeıioöuü]', '', 'g'); if position('ı' in low) > 0 then if regexp_replace(vowels, '[ıi]', '', 'g') ~ '^[eöü]+$' then low := replace(low, 'ı', 'i'); end if; end if; c := left(low, 1); return case c when 'i' then 'İ' when 'ı' then 'I' else upper(c) end || substr(low, 2); end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.review_pending_action(p_action_id uuid, p_approve boolean, p_note text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare a public.pending_actions; v_player uuid; v_jersey smallint; v_p jsonb; v_current public.season_team_players; begin select * into a from public.pending_actions where id = p_action_id for update; if not found then raise exception 'Talep bulunamadı.'; end if; if not (public.owns_league(a.league_id) or public.owns_season_team(a.season_id, a.team_id)) then raise exception 'Bu talebi inceleme yetkiniz yok.'; end if; if a.status <> 'pending' then raise exception 'Talep zaten sonuçlanmış (%).', a.status; end if; if p_approve then v_player := nullif(a.payload ->> 'player_id', '')::uuid; v_jersey := nullif(a.payload ->> 'jersey_number', '')::smallint; if a.action_type = 'roster_add' then if v_player is null then v_p := a.payload -> 'player'; if v_p is null or coalesce(trim(v_p ->> 'name'), '') = '' or coalesce(trim(v_p ->> 'surname'), '') = '' or nullif(v_p ->> 'birth_date', '') is null then raise exception 'Yeni oyuncu için ad, soyad ve doğum tarihi gerekli.'; end if; if not public.manual_player_create_allowed() then raise exception 'Yeni futbolcu ekleme kapalı. Futbolcu uygulamadan kayıt olsun; sonra listeden seçin.'; end if; insert into public.players ( name, surname, birth_date, phone, main_position, preferred_foot ) values ( trim(v_p ->> 'name'), trim(v_p ->> 'surname'), (v_p ->> 'birth_date')::date, public.phone_raw10(v_p ->> 'phone'), nullif(trim(v_p ->> 'main_position'), ''), nullif(trim(v_p ->> 'preferred_foot'), '') ) returning id into v_player; end if; select * into v_current from public.season_team_players where season_id = a.season_id and player_id = v_player; if found and v_current.is_active and v_current.team_id <> a.team_id then raise exception 'Oyuncu bu sezon başka bir takımda kayıtlı.'; end if; if found then update public.season_team_players set team_id = a.team_id, is_active = true, jersey_number = coalesce(v_jersey, jersey_number) where id = v_current.id; else insert into public.season_team_players ( season_id, team_id, player_id, jersey_number, is_active ) values (a.season_id, a.team_id, v_player, v_jersey, true); end if; elsif a.action_type = 'roster_remove' then update public.season_team_players set is_active = false where season_id = a.season_id and team_id = a.team_id and player_id = v_player; if not found then raise exception 'Oyuncu bu takımın kadrosunda değil.'; end if; elsif a.action_type = 'jersey_change' then if v_jersey is not null and exists ( select 1 from public.season_team_players where season_id = a.season_id and team_id = a.team_id and jersey_number = v_jersey and is_active and player_id <> v_player ) then raise exception 'Bu forma numarası takımda kullanılıyor.'; end if; update public.season_team_players set jersey_number = v_jersey where season_id = a.season_id and team_id = a.team_id and player_id = v_player and is_active; if not found then raise exception 'Oyuncu bu takımın aktif kadrosunda değil.'; end if; end if; end if; update public.pending_actions set status = case when p_approve then 'approved' else 'rejected' end, review_note = p_note, reviewed_by = auth.uid(), reviewed_at = now(), payload = case when p_approve and a.action_type = 'roster_add' and v_player is not null then payload || jsonb_build_object('player_id', v_player) else payload end where id = a.id; end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sms_otp_send(p_phone text, p_reset boolean DEFAULT false) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare v_raw text := public.phone_raw10(p_phone); v_has_account boolean; v_kind text; v_code text; v_provider text; v_key text; v_hash text; v_sender text; v_template text; v_request bigint; begin if not public.sms_otp_enabled() then return 'disabled'; end if; if v_raw is null or v_raw !~ '^5[0-9]{9}$' then return 'invalid_phone'; end if; select exists ( select 1 from auth.users where email = v_raw || '@masterclass.com' ) into v_has_account; if p_reset and not v_has_account and not exists ( select 1 from public.players p where public.phone_raw10(p.phone) = v_raw ) then return 'not_registered'; end if; -- Kayıt yalnızca oyuncu kaydında bulunan numaralara açık -- (request_account_password ile aynı kural). if not v_has_account and not exists ( select 1 from public.players p where public.phone_raw10(p.phone) = v_raw ) then return 'unknown_phone'; end if; -- Aynı numaraya 60 sn'de bir, saatte en fazla 5 kod. if exists ( select 1 from public.sms_otp_codes where phone_raw10 = v_raw and created_at > now() - interval '60 seconds' ) then return 'too_soon'; end if; if (select count(*) from public.sms_otp_codes where phone_raw10 = v_raw and created_at > now() - interval '1 hour') >= 5 then return 'too_many'; end if; select value #>> '{}' into v_provider from public.app_settings where key = 'sms_otp_provider'; v_provider := coalesce(v_provider, 'telegram'); v_kind := case when v_has_account then 'reset' else 'register' end; v_code := lpad( ((('x' || encode(extensions.gen_random_bytes(4), 'hex'))::bit(32)::bigint) % 1000000)::text, 6, '0'); if v_provider = 'iletimerkezi' then select value into v_key from public.app_private_settings where key = 'iletimerkezi_key'; select value into v_hash from public.app_private_settings where key = 'iletimerkezi_hash'; select value into v_sender from public.app_private_settings where key = 'iletimerkezi_sender'; select value into v_template from public.app_private_settings where key = 'sms_otp_template_' || v_kind; v_template := coalesce(nullif(v_template, ''), case when v_kind = 'reset' then 'Lig Masası şifre yenileme için doğrulama kodunuz: {kod}. Kodu kimseyle paylaşmayın.' else 'Lig Masası ilk şifre belirleme için doğrulama kodunuz: {kod}. Kodu kimseyle paylaşmayın.' end); if coalesce(v_key, '') = '' or coalesce(v_hash, '') = '' or coalesce(v_sender, '') = '' then return 'not_configured'; end if; -- iys=0: doğrulama kodu ticari ileti değildir (İYS onayı aranmaz). select net.http_post( url := 'https://api.iletimerkezi.com/v1/send-sms/json', body := jsonb_build_object('request', jsonb_build_object( 'authentication', jsonb_build_object('key', v_key, 'hash', v_hash), 'order', jsonb_build_object( 'sender', v_sender, 'sendDateTime', '', 'iys', '0', 'message', jsonb_build_object( 'text', replace(v_template, '{kod}', v_code), 'receipents', jsonb_build_object('number', jsonb_build_array(v_raw)) ) ) )), headers := '{"Content-Type": "application/json"}'::jsonb ) into v_request; else perform public.telegram_notify( array(select user_id from public.admins where user_id is not null), case when v_kind = 'reset' then '📱 SMS test kodu · ŞİFRE YENİLEME (hesabı var)' else '📱 SMS test kodu · YENİ KAYIT (ilk hesap)' end || E'\n' || public.format_phone_raw10(v_raw) || E'\nKod: ' || v_code ); end if; insert into public.sms_otp_codes ( phone_raw10, kind, code_hash, provider, request_id, expires_at ) values ( v_raw, v_kind, extensions.crypt(v_code, extensions.gen_salt('bf')), v_provider, v_request, now() + interval '3 minutes' ); return case when v_has_account then 'sent_reset' else 'sent' end; end; $function$

create or replace function public.review_identity_request(p_id uuid, p_approve boolean) returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path to '' as $$ declare r public.identity_verify_requests%rowtype; p public.players%rowtype; v_other text; begin select * into r from public.identity_verify_requests where id = p_id for update; if not found then raise exception 'Talep bulunamadı.'; end if; if not (public.is_admin() or public.owns_league((select s.league_id from public.seasons s where s.id = r.season_id))) then raise exception 'Bu talebi inceleme yetkiniz yok.'; end if; if r.status <> 'pending' then raise exception 'Talep zaten sonuçlanmış.'; end if; if p_approve then if r.tc_hash is null then raise exception 'Talep eksik. Kimliği yeniden okutun.'; end if; select pl.name || ' ' || pl.surname into v_other from public.player_verifications v join public.players pl on pl.id = v.player_id where v.tc_hash = r.tc_hash and v.player_id <> r.player_id; if v_other is not null then raise exception 'Bu kimlik başka bir profile onaylı: %.', v_other; end if; if exists (select 1 from public.player_verifications where player_id = r.player_id and tc_hash <> r.tc_hash) then raise exception 'Profil başka bir kimlikle onaylanmış.'; end if; select * into p from public.players where id = r.player_id; update public.players set birth_date = r.card_birth, name = case when public._id_words_match(name, r.card_first) then name else r.card_first end, surname = case when public._id_fold(surname) = public._id_fold(r.card_last) then surname else r.card_last end where id = r.player_id; insert into public.identity_events (player_id, action, user_id) values (r.player_id, 'correct: ' || coalesce(p.name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.surname, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.birth_date::text, '-'), auth.uid()); insert into public.player_verifications (player_id, tc_hash, verified_by) values (r.player_id, r.tc_hash, r.requested_by) on conflict (player_id) do nothing; insert into public.identity_events (player_id, action, user_id) values (r.player_id, 'verify', auth.uid()); end if; update public.identity_verify_requests set status = case when p_approve then 'approved' else 'rejected' end, decided_by = auth.uid(), decided_at = now(), tc_hash = null where id = r.id; perform public.push_send( array[r.requested_by], case when p_approve then 'Kimlik onaylandı' else 'Kimlik onayı reddedildi' end, (select trim(name || ' ' || surname) from public.players where id = r.player_id), '/', 'roster-idv-' || r.id ); end; $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.identity_add_to_season_roster(p_season_id uuid, p_team_id uuid, p_first text, p_last text, p_birth date, p_tc text, p_player_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_jersey smallint DEFAULT NULL::smallint, p_display text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare v_staff boolean; v_hash text; v_player uuid := p_player_id; v_first text := initcap(lower(trim(p_first))); v_last text := initcap(lower(trim(p_last))); v_disp text[]; v_cur public.season_team_players; v_name text; begin perform public._identity_guard(p_tc); if not exists (select 1 from public.season_teams where season_id = p_season_id and team_id = p_team_id) then raise exception 'Takım bu turnuvada değil.'; end if; v_staff := public.owns_season_team(p_season_id, p_team_id); if not v_staff and not public.attendance_is_manager(p_season_id, p_team_id) then raise exception 'Bu takıma oyuncu ekleme yetkiniz yok.'; end if; v_hash := public._identity_hash(p_tc); if v_player is not null then -- Seçilen mevcut profil kimlikle onaylanır (kurallar identity_verify'da). perform public.identity_verify(v_player, p_first, p_last, p_birth, p_tc); else select player_id into v_player from public.player_verifications where tc_hash = v_hash; if v_player is null then -- Çip adı Türkçe harf taşımaz; kağıttaki yazım aynı harflerse o kullanılır. v_disp := regexp_split_to_array(trim(coalesce(p_display, '')), '\s+'); v_last := v_disp[array_length(v_disp, 1)]; end if; insert into public.players (name, surname, birth_date) values (v_first, v_last, p_birth) returning id into v_player; insert into public.player_verifications (player_id, tc_hash, verified_by) values (v_player, v_hash, auth.uid()); insert into public.identity_events (player_id, action, user_id) values (v_player, 'create', auth.uid()), (v_player, 'verify', auth.uid()); end if; end if; select trim(coalesce(name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(surname, '')) into v_name from public.players where id = v_player; select * into v_cur from public.season_team_players where season_id = p_season_id and player_id = v_player order by is_active desc limit 1; if found and v_cur.is_active and v_cur.team_id <> p_team_id then raise exception '% bu sezon başka bir takımda kayıtlı.', v_name; end if; if found and v_cur.is_active then return jsonb_build_object('status', 'added', 'player_id', v_player, 'name', v_name); end if; if v_staff then if found then update public.season_team_players set team_id = p_team_id, is_active = true, jersey_number = coalesce(p_jersey, jersey_number) where id = v_cur.id; else insert into public.season_team_players (season_id, team_id, player_id, jersey_number, is_active) values (p_season_id, p_team_id, v_player, p_jersey, true); end if; return jsonb_build_object('status', 'added', 'player_id', v_player, 'name', v_name); end if; insert into public.pending_actions (action_type, season_id, team_id, payload) values ('roster_add', p_season_id, p_team_id, jsonb_build_object( 'player_id', v_player, 'player_name', v_name, 'jersey_number', p_jersey, 'via', 'identity')) on conflict do nothing; return jsonb_build_object('status', 'pending', 'player_id', v_player, 'name', v_name); end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.register_player(p_phone text, p_code text, p_password text, p_first text, p_last text, p_birth date, p_tc text, p_main text, p_sub text, p_foot text, p_height integer, p_weight integer) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare v_raw text := public.phone_raw10(p_phone); end if; if p_password is null or length(p_password) not between 6 and 10 or p_password !~ '[^A-Za-z]' then return 'weak_password'; end if; if exists (select 1 from auth.users where email = v_raw || '@masterclass.com') then return 'has_account'; end if; v_hash := public._identity_hash(p_tc); -- Aynı kişi: önce TC onayı, sonra numarası (kodla doğrulanır) kayıtlı -- profil, yoksa ad + soyad + doğum tarihi tutan onaysız profil. select v.player_id, p.auth_uid into v_player, v_auth from public.player_verifications v join public.players p on p.id = v.player_id where v.tc_hash = v_hash; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sms_otp_send(p_phone text, p_reset boolean DEFAULT false) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare v_raw text := public.phone_raw10(p_phone); v_has_account boolean; v_kind text; v_code text; v_provider text; v_key text; v_hash text; v_sender text; v_template text; v_request bigint; begin if not public.sms_otp_enabled() then return 'disabled'; end if; if v_raw is null or v_raw !~ '^5[0-9]{9}$' then return 'invalid_phone'; end if; select exists ( select 1 from auth.users where email = v_raw || '@masterclass.com' ) into v_has_account; if p_reset and not v_has_account and not exists ( select 1 from public.players p where public.phone_raw10(p.phone) = v_raw ) then return 'not_registered'; end if; -- Kayıt yalnızca oyuncu kaydında bulunan numaralara açık -- (request_account_password ile aynı kural). if not v_has_account and not exists ( select 1 from public.players p where public.phone_raw10(p.phone) = v_raw ) then return 'unknown_phone'; end if; -- Aynı numaraya 60 sn'de bir, saatte en fazla 5 kod. if exists ( select 1 from public.sms_otp_codes where phone_raw10 = v_raw and created_at > now() - interval '60 seconds' ) then return 'too_soon'; end if; if (select count(*) from public.sms_otp_codes where phone_raw10 = v_raw and created_at > now() - interval '1 hour') >= 5 then return 'too_many'; end if; select value #>> '{}' into v_provider from public.app_settings where key = 'sms_otp_provider'; v_provider := coalesce(v_provider, 'telegram'); v_kind := case when v_has_account then 'reset' else 'register' end; v_code := lpad( ((('x' || encode(extensions.gen_random_bytes(4), 'hex'))::bit(32)::bigint) % 1000000)::text, 6, '0'); if v_provider = 'iletimerkezi' then select value into v_key from public.app_private_settings where key = 'iletimerkezi_key'; select value into v_hash from public.app_private_settings where key = 'iletimerkezi_hash'; select value into v_sender from public.app_private_settings where key = 'iletimerkezi_sender'; select value into v_template from public.app_private_settings where key = 'sms_otp_template_' || v_kind; v_template := coalesce(nullif(v_template, ''), case when v_kind = 'reset' then 'Lig Masası şifre yenileme kodunuz: {kod}. 3 dakika geçerlidir, kimseyle paylaşmayın.' else 'Lig Masası kayıt kodunuz: {kod}. 3 dakika geçerlidir, kimseyle paylaşmayın.' end); if coalesce(v_key, '') = '' or coalesce(v_hash, '') = '' or coalesce(v_sender, '') = '' then return 'not_configured'; end if; -- iys=0: doğrulama kodu ticari ileti değildir (İYS onayı aranmaz). select net.http_post( url := 'https://api.iletimerkezi.com/v1/send-sms/json', body := jsonb_build_object('request', jsonb_build_object( 'authentication', jsonb_build_object('key', v_key, 'hash', v_hash), 'order', jsonb_build_object( 'sender', v_sender, 'sendDateTime', '', 'iys', '0', 'message', jsonb_build_object( 'text', replace(v_template, '{kod}', v_code), 'receipents', jsonb_build_object('number', jsonb_build_array(v_raw)) ) ) )), headers := '{"Content-Type": "application/json"}'::jsonb ) into v_request; else perform public.telegram_notify( array(select user_id from public.admins where user_id is not null), case when v_kind = 'reset' then '📱 SMS test kodu · ŞİFRE YENİLEME (hesabı var)' else '📱 SMS test kodu · YENİ KAYIT (ilk hesap)' end || E'\n' || public.format_phone_raw10(v_raw) || E'\nKod: ' || v_code ); end if; insert into public.sms_otp_codes ( phone_raw10, kind, code_hash, provider, request_id, expires_at ) values ( v_raw, v_kind, extensions.crypt(v_code, extensions.gen_salt('bf')), v_provider, v_request, now() + interval '3 minutes' ); return case when v_has_account then 'sent_reset' else 'sent' end; end; $function$
