CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.register_player(p_phone text, p_code text, p_password text, p_first text, p_last text, p_birth date, p_tc text, p_main text, p_sub text, p_foot text, p_height integer, p_weight integer) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare v_raw text := public.phone_raw10(p_phone); v_first text := btrim(coalesce(p_first, '')); v_last text := btrim(coalesce(p_last, '')); v_hash text; v_player uuid; v_auth uuid; v_count int; v_uid uuid; v_res text; v_phone_owner uuid; begin if not public.self_registration_enabled() then return 'disabled'; end if; if v_raw is null or v_raw !~ '^5[0-9]{9}$' then return 'invalid_phone'; end if; if not public.tc_valid(p_tc) then return 'invalid_tc'; end if; if length(v_first) < 2 or length(v_last) < 2 or p_birth is null or p_birth < date '1940-01-01' or p_birth > (current_date - interval '10 years')::date or coalesce(p_main, '') not in ('Kaleci', 'Defans', 'Orta Saha', 'Forvet') or (p_sub is not null and p_sub not in ('Stoper', 'Sol Bek', 'Sağ Bek', 'Defansif', 'Merkez', 'Ofansif', 'Sol Kanat', 'Sağ Kanat', 'Santrfor', 'Sol Kanat Forvet', 'Sağ Kanat Forvet')) or (p_foot is not null and p_foot not in ('Sağ', 'Sol', 'Her İkisi')) or (p_height is not null and p_height not between 120 and 230) or (p_weight is not null and p_weight not between 35 and 200) then return 'invalid_data'; end if; if p_password is null or length(p_password) not between 6 and 10 or p_password !~ '[^A-Za-z]' then return 'weak_password'; end if; if exists (select 1 from auth.users where email = v_raw || '@masterclass.com') then return 'has_account'; end if; v_hash := public._identity_hash(p_tc); -- Aynı kişi: önce TC onayı, yoksa ad + soyad + doğum tarihi tutan -- onaysız profil. select v.player_id, p.auth_uid into v_player, v_auth from public.player_verifications v join public.players p on p.id = v.player_id where v.tc_hash = v_hash; if v_player is null then select count(*), min(p.id::text)::uuid into v_count, v_player from public.players p where (p.birth_date = p_birth -- Yalnız yılı bilinen profil (01.01): aynı yıl yeter. or (to_char(p.birth_date, 'MM-DD') = '01-01' and extract(year from p.birth_date) = extract(year from p_birth))) and public.tr_fold(p.surname) = public.tr_fold(v_last) and (public.tr_fold(p.name) = public.tr_fold(v_first) or public.tr_fold(v_first) like public.tr_fold(p.name) || ' %' or public.tr_fold(p.name) like public.tr_fold(v_first) || ' %') and not exists (select 1 from public.player_verifications v where v.player_id = p.id); if v_count > 1 then return 'ambiguous'; end if; if v_player is not null then select auth_uid into v_auth from public.players where id = v_player; end if; end if; if v_auth is not null then return 'profile_has_account'; end if; -- Numara başka bir profilde kayıtlıysa: ad soyad tutan onaysız profil -- o kişidir (bağlanır); tutmuyorsa numara başkasınındır. select p.id into v_phone_owner from public.players p where p.phone = v_raw; if v_phone_owner is not null and v_phone_owner is distinct from v_player then if v_player is null and exists ( select 1 from public.players p where p.id = v_phone_owner and p.auth_uid is null and public.tr_fold(p.surname) = public.tr_fold(v_last) and (public.tr_fold(p.name) = public.tr_fold(v_first) or public.tr_fold(v_first) like public.tr_fold(p.name) || ' %' or public.tr_fold(p.name) like public.tr_fold(v_first) || ' %') and not exists (select 1 from public.player_verifications v where v.player_id = p.id) ) then v_player := v_phone_owner; else return 'phone_taken'; end if; end if; v_res := public._otp_consume(v_raw, p_code); if v_res <> 'ok' then return v_res; end if; if v_player is null then insert into public.players ( name, surname, birth_date, phone, main_position, sub_position, preferred_foot, height, weight ) values ( v_first, v_last, p_birth, v_raw, p_main, p_sub, p_foot, p_height, p_weight ) returning id into v_player; else -- Mevcut profil: kişinin kendi girdikleri yazılır; ad profildeki gibi -- kalır, doğum tarihi kimlikteki tarihle düzelir. update public.players set phone = v_raw, -- Doğum tarihi kimlik çipindekiyle düzelir (aynı ad soyad ve -- tarihte başka profil yoksa; players_identity_uq). birth_date = case when exists ( select 1 from public.players o where o.id <> v_player and public.norm_person_name(o.name::text) = public.norm_person_name(name::text) and public.norm_person_name(o.surname) = public.norm_person_name(surname) and o.birth_date = p_birth) then birth_date else p_birth end, main_position = p_main, sub_position = case when p_main = 'Kaleci' then null else coalesce(p_sub, sub_position) end, preferred_foot = coalesce(p_foot, preferred_foot), height = coalesce(p_height, height), weight = coalesce(p_weight, weight) where id = v_player; end if; v_uid := public.set_phone_account_password( v_raw, p_password, false, v_first || ' ' || v_last); -- Hesap açılırken aynı numaralı başka bir kayıt bağlandıysa düzeltilir. update public.players set auth_uid = null where auth_uid = v_uid and id <> v_player; update public.players set auth_uid = v_uid where id = v_player; insert into public.player_verifications (player_id, tc_hash, verified_by) values (v_player, v_hash, v_uid) on conflict (player_id) do nothing; insert into public.identity_events (player_id, action, user_id) values (v_player, 'register', v_uid); return 'ok'; end; $function$

create or replace function public.sms_balance_tick() returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path to '' as $$ declare v_req bigint; v_content text; v_bal int; v_thr int; v_alerted boolean; v_key text; v_hash text; v_new bigint; v_admins uuid[] := (select array_agg(user_id) from public.admins where user_id is not null); begin select nullif(value, '')::bigint into v_req from public.app_private_settings where key = 'sms_balance_req'; if v_req is not null then select content into v_content from net._http_response where id = v_req and status_code = 200; if v_content is not null then begin v_bal := (v_content::jsonb #>> '{response,balance,sms}')::int; exception when others then v_bal := null; end; if v_bal is not null then insert into public.app_private_settings (key, value) values ('sms_balance', v_bal::text), ('sms_balance_at', now()::text) on conflict (key) do update set value = excluded.value; v_thr := coalesce((select (value #>> '{}')::int from public.app_settings where key = 'sms_low_threshold'), 1000); v_alerted := coalesce((select value from public.app_private_settings where key = 'sms_balance_alerted'), 'false') = 'true'; if v_bal < v_thr and not v_alerted then insert into public.app_private_settings (key, value) values ('sms_balance_alerted', 'true') on conflict (key) do update set value = 'true'; if v_admins is not null then perform public.telegram_notify( v_admins, '⚠️ SMS bakiyeniz ' || replace(to_char(v_thr, 'FM999,999'), ',', '.') || '''in altına düştü: ' || replace(to_char(v_bal, 'FM999,999'), ',', '.') || ' SMS kaldı. İletiMerkezi › Ödemeler › SMS Satın Al.'); end if; elsif v_bal >= v_thr and v_alerted then update public.app_private_settings set value = 'false' where key = 'sms_balance_alerted'; end if; end if; end if; end if; select value into v_key from public.app_private_settings where key = 'iletimerkezi_key'; select value into v_hash from public.app_private_settings where key = 'iletimerkezi_hash'; if coalesce(v_key, '') = '' or coalesce(v_hash, '') = '' then return; end if; select net.http_post( url := 'https://api.iletimerkezi.com/v1/get-balance/json', body := jsonb_build_object('request', jsonb_build_object( 'authentication', jsonb_build_object('key', v_key, 'hash', v_hash))), headers := '{"Content-Type": "application/json"}'::jsonb ) into v_new; insert into public.app_private_settings (key, value) values ('sms_balance_req', v_new::text) on conflict (key) do update set value = excluded.value; end; $$

create or replace function public.admin_registrations(p_limit integer default 200) returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path to '' as $function$ begin if not public.is_admin() then return '[]'::jsonb; end if; return coalesce(( select jsonb_agg(r order by (r->>'created_at') desc) from ( select jsonb_build_object( 'id', u.id, 'created_at', u.created_at, 'last_sign_in', u.last_sign_in_at, 'name', coalesce( nullif(trim(concat_ws(' ', pl.name, pl.surname)), ''), nullif(u.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'name', ''), au.name), 'phone', case when split_part(u.email, '@', 1) ~ '^5[0-9]{9}$' then split_part(u.email, '@', 1) end, 'kind', case when pl.id is not null then 'player' when au.role = 'fan' then 'fan' when exists (select 1 from public.leagues l where l.owner_id = u.id) then 'organizer' when exists (select 1 from public.region_owners ro where ro.user_id = u.id) then 'organizer' else coalesce(au.role, 'other') end, 'verified', case when pl.id is null then null when exists (select 1 from public.identity_pending ip where ip.player_id = pl.id) then 'pending' else (select v.method from public.player_verifications v where v.player_id = pl.id) end ) as r from auth.users u left join public.players pl on pl.auth_uid = u.id left join public.app_users au on au.auth_uid = u.id::text where split_part(u.email, '@', 2) = 'masterclass.com' order by u.created_at desc limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 200), 1000)) ) t ), '[]'::jsonb); end; $function$

create or replace function public.auto_motm_pick(p_match uuid) returns table (player_id uuid, team_id uuid, rating numeric) language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path to '' as $$ declare m public.matches%rowtype; v_rules jsonb; v_end int; begin select * into m from public.matches where id = p_match; if m.id is null or m.status <> 'finished' then return; end if; select s.player_rating, coalesce(nullif(s.match_period_duration, 0), 45) * 2 into v_rules, v_end from public.seasons s where s.id = m.season_id; if coalesce((v_rules ->> 'enabled')::boolean, false) is not true then return; end if; return query with rv as ( select k, coalesce((v_rules -> 'rules' ->> k)::numeric, d) as v from (values ('base', 7.0), ('goal', 1.0), ('pen_goal', 0.7), ('assist', 0.5), ('win', 0.3), ('loss', -0.3), ('cs_gk', 1.0), ('cs_def', 0.5), ('motm', 0.5), ('yellow', -0.5), ('second_yellow', -1.0), ('red', -2.0), ('own_goal', -1.0), ('min_minutes', 10), ('sub_base', 6.5), ('full_bonus', 0.2), ('cs_minutes', 60)) x(k, d) ), r as (select jsonb_object_agg(k, v) as j from rv), ro as ( select mr.player_id, mr.team_id, coalesce(mr.is_starting, false) as starter, coalesce(mr.list_order, 999) as ord, mr.created_at, public._position_line(p.main_position, p.sub_position) as pline from public.match_rosters mr join public.players p on p.id = mr.player_id where mr.match_id = p_match and mr.team_id in (m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id) ), gk as ( -- Sahadaki kaleci: ilk 11'de kaleci mevkili ilk oyuncu, yoksa ilk 11'in ilki. select distinct on (ro.team_id) ro.team_id, ro.player_id from ro where ro.starter order by ro.team_id, (ro.pline <> 0), ro.ord, ro.created_at ), ev as ( select e.player_id as pid, count(*) filter (where e.event_type = 'goal' and not coalesce(e.is_own_goal, false) and not coalesce(e.is_penalty, false)) as goals, count(*) filter (where e.event_type = 'goal' and not coalesce(e.is_own_goal, false) and coalesce(e.is_penalty, false)) as pens, count(*) filter (where e.event_type = 'goal' and coalesce(e.is_own_goal, false)) as owns, count(*) filter (where e.event_type = 'yellow_card') as yellows, count(*) filter (where e.event_type = 'red_card') as reds, min(e.minute) filter (where e.event_type = 'red_card') as red_min, bool_or(e.event_type = 'substitution') as subbed_out, min(e.minute) filter (where e.event_type = 'substitution') as out_min, bool_or(e.event_type = 'man_of_the_match') as motm from public.match_events e where e.match_id = p_match and e.player_id is not null group by e.player_id ), asg as ( select e.assist_player_id as pid, count(*) as assists from public.match_events e where e.match_id = p_match and e.event_type = 'goal' and not coalesce(e.is_own_goal, false) and e.assist_player_id is not null group by 1 ), sin as ( select e.sub_in_player_id as pid, min(e.minute) as in_min from public.match_events e where e.match_id = p_match and e.event_type = 'substitution' and e.sub_in_player_id is not null group by 1 ), mo as ( select mm.player_id as pid, sum(coalesce((v_rules -> 'moments' ->> mm.kind)::numeric, case mm.kind when 'save' then 0.3 when 'one_on_one' then 0.5 when 'pen_save' then 1.0 when 'gk_error' then -0.5 when 'tackle' then 0.3 when 'line_clear' then 0.5 when 'interception' then 0.2 when 'pen_conceded' then -0.5 when 'key_pass' then 0.3 when 'recovery' then 0.2 when 'woodwork' then 0.2 when 'bad_loss' then -0.5 when 'pen_won' then 0.5 when 'big_miss' then -0.3 when 'pen_miss' then -1.0 when 'error_goal' then -1.0 else 0 end)) as pts from public.match_moments mm where mm.match_id = p_match group by 1 ), base as ( select ro.player_id, ro.team_id, ro.starter, ro.ord, (ro.team_id = m.home_team_id) as home, case when ro.starter and gk.player_id = ro.player_id then 0 when ro.pline = 0 then 1 else ro.pline end as line, coalesce(ev.goals, 0) as goals, coalesce(ev.pens, 0) as pens, coalesce(ev.owns, 0) as owns, coalesce(asg.assists, 0) as assists, coalesce(ev.yellows, 0) as yellows, coalesce(ev.reds, 0) as reds, ev.red_min, coalesce(ev.subbed_out, false) as subbed_out, ev.out_min, coalesce(ev.motm, false) as motm, sin.pid is not null as subbed_in, sin.in_min, coalesce(mo.pts, 0) as moments from ro left join gk on gk.team_id = ro.team_id left join ev on ev.pid = ro.player_id left join asg on asg.pid = ro.player_id left join sin on sin.pid = ro.player_id left join mo on mo.pid = ro.player_id ), played as ( select b.*, greatest(0, least(case when b.subbed_out then coalesce(b.out_min, v_end) else v_end end, case when b.reds > 0 then coalesce(b.red_min, v_end) else v_end end) - case when b.starter then 0 else coalesce(b.in_min, v_end) end) as mins from base b where b.starter or b.subbed_in ), rated as ( select pl.player_id, pl.team_id, pl.home, pl.ord, pl.goals + pl.pens as g, pl.assists, round(least(10, greatest(3, case when pl.starter then (r.j->>'base')::numeric else (r.j->>'sub_base')::numeric end + (r.j->>'goal')::numeric * pl.goals + (r.j->>'pen_goal')::numeric * pl.pens + (r.j->>'assist')::numeric * pl.assists + (r.j->>'own_goal')::numeric * pl.owns + case when pl.motm then (r.j->>'motm')::numeric else 0 end + case when pl.reds > 0 and pl.yellows > 0 then (r.j->>'second_yellow')::numeric + (r.j->>'yellow')::numeric * (pl.yellows - 1) else (r.j->>'yellow')::numeric * pl.yellows + (r.j->>'red')::numeric * pl.reds end + case when pl.mins >= 60 then (r.j->>'full_bonus')::numeric else 0 end + case when (case when pl.home then m.home_score else m.away_score end) > (case when pl.home then m.away_score else m.home_score end) then (r.j->>'win')::numeric when (case when pl.home then m.home_score else m.away_score end) < (case when pl.home then m.away_score else m.home_score end) then (r.j->>'loss')::numeric else 0 end + case when (case when pl.home then m.away_score else m.home_score end) = 0 and pl.mins >= (r.j->>'cs_minutes')::numeric then case pl.line when 0 then (r.j->>'cs_gk')::numeric when 1 then (r.j->>'cs_def')::numeric else 0 end else 0 end + pl.moments)), 1) as rating from played pl, r where pl.mins >= (r.j->>'min_minutes')::numeric ) select x.player_id, x.team_id, x.rating from rated x order by x.rating desc, x.g desc, x.assists desc, x.home desc, x.ord limit 1; end; $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.review_pending_action(p_action_id uuid, p_approve boolean, p_note text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare a public.pending_actions; v_player uuid; v_jersey smallint; v_p jsonb; v_current public.season_team_players; begin select * into a from public.pending_actions where id = p_action_id for update; if not found then raise exception 'Talep bulunamadı.'; end if; if not (public.owns_league(a.league_id) or public.owns_season_team(a.season_id, a.team_id)) then raise exception 'Bu talebi inceleme yetkiniz yok.'; end if; if a.status <> 'pending' then raise exception 'Talep zaten sonuçlanmış (%).', a.status; end if; if p_approve then v_player := nullif(a.payload ->> 'player_id', '')::uuid; v_jersey := nullif(a.payload ->> 'jersey_number', '')::smallint; if a.action_type = 'roster_add' then if v_player is null then v_p := a.payload -> 'player'; if v_p is null or coalesce(trim(v_p ->> 'name'), '') = '' or coalesce(trim(v_p ->> 'surname'), '') = '' or nullif(v_p ->> 'birth_date', '') is null then raise exception 'Yeni oyuncu için ad, soyad ve doğum tarihi gerekli.'; end if; if not public.manual_player_create_allowed() then raise exception 'Yeni futbolcu ekleme kapalı. Futbolcu uygulamadan kayıt olsun; sonra listeden seçin.'; end if; insert into public.players ( name, surname, birth_date, phone, main_position, preferred_foot ) values ( trim(v_p ->> 'name'), trim(v_p ->> 'surname'), (v_p ->> 'birth_date')::date, public.phone_raw10(v_p ->> 'phone'), nullif(trim(v_p ->> 'main_position'), ''), nullif(trim(v_p ->> 'preferred_foot'), '') ) returning id into v_player; end if; select * into v_current from public.season_team_players where season_id = a.season_id and player_id = v_player; if found and v_current.is_active and v_current.team_id <> a.team_id then raise exception 'Oyuncu bu sezon başka bir takımda kayıtlı.'; end if; if found then update public.season_team_players set team_id = a.team_id, is_active = true, jersey_number = coalesce(v_jersey, jersey_number) where id = v_current.id; else insert into public.season_team_players ( season_id, team_id, player_id, jersey_number, is_active ) values (a.season_id, a.team_id, v_player, v_jersey, true); end if; -- Esameden (kimlikle) gelen talep: oyuncu o maçın esamesine de yazılır -- (maç başlamış ya da bitmiş olsa da; yedek olarak, listenin sonuna). if nullif(a.payload ->> 'match_id', '') is not null then insert into public.match_rosters ( match_id, league_id, season_id, team_id, player_id, is_home, is_starting, jersey_number, list_order ) select m.id, m.league_id, m.season_id, a.team_id, v_player, (m.home_team_id = a.team_id)::text, false, coalesce(v_jersey, (select stp.jersey_number from public.season_team_players stp where stp.season_id = a.season_id and stp.player_id = v_player and stp.is_active limit 1)), (select coalesce(max(mr.list_order) + 1, 0) from public.match_rosters mr where mr.match_id = m.id and mr.team_id = a.team_id) from public.matches m where m.id = (a.payload ->> 'match_id')::uuid and a.team_id in (m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id) and not exists (select 1 from public.match_rosters mr where mr.match_id = m.id and mr.player_id = v_player); end if; elsif a.action_type = 'roster_remove' then update public.season_team_players set is_active = false where season_id = a.season_id and team_id = a.team_id and player_id = v_player; if not found then raise exception 'Oyuncu bu takımın kadrosunda değil.'; end if; elsif a.action_type = 'jersey_change' then if v_jersey is not null and exists ( select 1 from public.season_team_players where season_id = a.season_id and team_id = a.team_id and jersey_number = v_jersey and is_active and player_id <> v_player ) then raise exception 'Bu forma numarası takımda kullanılıyor.'; end if; update public.season_team_players set jersey_number = v_jersey where season_id = a.season_id and team_id = a.team_id and player_id = v_player and is_active; if not found then raise exception 'Oyuncu bu takımın aktif kadrosunda değil.'; end if; end if; end if; update public.pending_actions set status = case when p_approve then 'approved' else 'rejected' end, review_note = p_note, reviewed_by = auth.uid(), reviewed_at = now(), payload = case when p_approve and a.action_type = 'roster_add' and v_player is not null then payload || jsonb_build_object('player_id', v_player) else payload end where id = a.id; end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.register_player(p_phone text, p_code text, p_password text, p_first text, p_last text, p_birth date, p_tc text, p_main text, p_sub text, p_foot text, p_height integer, p_weight integer) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare v_raw text := public.phone_raw10(p_phone); v_first text := btrim(coalesce(p_first, '')); v_last text := btrim(coalesce(p_last, '')); v_hash text; v_player uuid; v_auth uuid; v_count int; v_uid uuid; v_res text; v_phone_owner uuid; v_new_first text; v_new_last text; v_new_birth date; begin if not public.self_registration_enabled() then return 'disabled'; end if; if v_raw is null or v_raw !~ '^5[0-9]{9}$' then return 'invalid_phone'; end if; if not public.tc_valid(p_tc) then return 'invalid_tc'; end if; if length(v_first) < 2 or length(v_last) < 2 or p_birth is null or p_birth < date '1940-01-01' or p_birth > (current_date - interval '10 years')::date or coalesce(p_main, '') not in ('Kaleci', 'Defans', 'Orta Saha', 'Forvet') or (p_sub is not null and p_sub not in ('Stoper', 'Sol Bek', 'Sağ Bek', 'Defansif', 'Merkez', 'Ofansif', 'Sol Kanat', 'Sağ Kanat', 'Santrfor', 'Sol Kanat Forvet', 'Sağ Kanat Forvet')) or (p_foot is not null and p_foot not in ('Sağ', 'Sol', 'Her İkisi')) or (p_height is not null and p_height not between 120 and 230) or (p_weight is not null and p_weight not between 35 and 200) then return 'invalid_data'; end if; if p_password is null or length(p_password) not between 6 and 10 or p_password !~ '[^A-Za-z]' then return 'weak_password'; end if; if exists (select 1 from auth.users where email = v_raw || '@masterclass.com') then return 'has_account'; end if; v_hash := public._identity_hash(p_tc); -- Aynı kişi: önce TC onayı, sonra numarası (kodla doğrulanır) kayıtlı -- profil, yoksa ad + soyad + doğum tarihi tutan onaysız profil. select v.player_id, p.auth_uid into v_player, v_auth from public.player_verifications v join public.players p on p.id = v.player_id where v.tc_hash = v_hash; if v_player is null then select p.id into v_phone_owner from public.players p where p.phone = v_raw; if v_phone_owner is not null then -- Başka bir kimlikle onaylı ya da hesabı olan profil: numara başkasının. if exists (select 1 from public.player_verifications v where v.player_id = v_phone_owner) or exists (select 1 from public.players p where p.id = v_phone_owner and p.auth_uid is not null) then return 'phone_taken'; end if; v_player := v_phone_owner; end if; end if; if v_player is null then select count(*), min(p.id::text)::uuid into v_count, v_player from public.players p where (p.birth_date = p_birth -- Yalnız yılı bilinen profil (01.01): aynı yıl yeter. or (to_char(p.birth_date, 'MM-DD') = '01-01' and extract(year from p.birth_date) = extract(year from p_birth))) and (' ' || public._id_fold(v_last) || ' ' like '% ' || public._id_fold(p.surname) || ' %' or ' ' || public._id_fold(p.surname) || ' ' like '% ' || public._id_fold(v_last) || ' %') and (' ' || public._id_fold(v_first) || ' ' like '% ' || public._id_fold(p.name) || ' %' or ' ' || public._id_fold(p.name) || ' ' like '% ' || public._id_fold(v_first) || ' %') and not exists (select 1 from public.player_verifications v where v.player_id = p.id); if v_count > 1 then return 'ambiguous'; end if; if v_player is not null then select auth_uid into v_auth from public.players where id = v_player; end if; end if; if v_auth is not null then return 'profile_has_account'; end if; -- Kimlikle bulunan profil başka, numara başka bir profilde: numara -- başkasının. select p.id into v_phone_owner from public.players p where p.phone = v_raw; if v_phone_owner is not null and v_phone_owner is distinct from v_player then return 'phone_taken'; end if; v_res := public._otp_consume(v_raw, p_code); if v_res <> 'ok' then return v_res; end if; if v_player is null then insert into public.players ( name, surname, birth_date, phone, main_position, sub_position, preferred_foot, height, weight ) values ( v_first, v_last, p_birth, v_raw, p_main, p_sub, p_foot, p_height, p_weight ) returning id into v_player; else -- Mevcut profil: kişinin kendi girdikleri ve kimlikteki bilgiler yazılır. -- Ad, soyad ve doğum tarihi kimlik çipindekiyle güncellenir. Ad yalnız -- gerçekten farklıysa değişir (Aktaş ↔ AKTAS gibi harf farkı değil). -- Aynı ad soyad ve tarihte başka profil varsa (players_identity_uq) -- profildeki kimlik bilgileri olduğu gibi kalır. select case when public._id_fold(p.name) = public._id_fold(v_first) then p.name else v_first end, case when public._id_fold(p.surname) = public._id_fold(v_last) then p.surname else v_last end into v_new_first, v_new_last from public.players p where p.id = v_player; if exists (select 1 from public.players o where o.id <> v_player and public.norm_person_name(o.name::text) = public.norm_person_name(v_new_first) and public.norm_person_name(o.surname) = public.norm_person_name(v_new_last) and o.birth_date = p_birth) then select p.name, p.surname, p.birth_date into v_new_first, v_new_last, v_new_birth from public.players p where p.id = v_player; else v_new_birth := p_birth; end if; update public.players set phone = v_raw, name = v_new_first, surname = v_new_last, birth_date = v_new_birth, main_position = p_main, sub_position = case when p_main = 'Kaleci' then null else coalesce(p_sub, sub_position) end, preferred_foot = coalesce(p_foot, preferred_foot), height = coalesce(p_height, height), weight = coalesce(p_weight, weight) where id = v_player; end if; v_uid := public.set_phone_account_password( v_raw, p_password, false, v_first || ' ' || v_last); -- Hesap açılırken aynı numaralı başka bir kayıt bağlandıysa düzeltilir. update public.players set auth_uid = null where auth_uid = v_uid and id <> v_player; update public.players set auth_uid = v_uid where id = v_player; insert into public.player_verifications (player_id, tc_hash, verified_by) values (v_player, v_hash, v_uid) on conflict (player_id) do nothing; insert into public.identity_events (player_id, action, user_id) values (v_player, 'register', v_uid); return 'ok'; end; $function$

create or replace function public.advance_match_phase( p_match_id uuid, p_action text ) returns public.matches language plpgsql security definer set search_path to '' as $$ declare m public.matches; dur int; begin if not public.can_manage_match(p_match_id) then raise exception 'Bu maçı yönetme yetkiniz yok.' using errcode = '42501'; end if; select * into m from public.matches where id = p_match_id for update; if not found then raise exception 'Maç bulunamadı.'; end if; select coalesce(nullif(s.match_period_duration, 0), 30) into dur from public.seasons s where s.id = m.season_id; dur := coalesce(dur, 30); if p_action = 'start' then -- Ertelenen maç yeni tarihinde doğrudan başlatılabilir. if m.status not in ('notStarted', 'postponed') then raise exception 'Maç zaten başlamış.'; end if; update public.matches set status = 'live', kickoff_at = now(), second_half_at = null, extra_time_at = null, shootout = null, home_pens = null, away_pens = null, is_completed = false where id = p_match_id; elsif p_action = 'end_first_half' then if m.status <> 'live' or m.second_half_at is not null then raise exception 'İlk yarı oynanmıyor.'; end if; update public.matches set status = 'halftime' where id = p_match_id; elsif p_action = 'start_second_half' then if m.status <> 'halftime' then raise exception 'Maç devre arasında değil.'; end if; update public.matches set status = 'live', second_half_at = now() where id = p_match_id; elsif p_action = 'start_extra_time' then if m.status <> 'live' or m.second_half_at is null or m.extra_time_at is not null or m.shootout is not null then raise exception 'Uzatmaya geçilemez.'; end if; if m.tiebreak is distinct from 'et_pens' then raise exception 'Bu maçta uzatma oynanmaz.'; end if; if m.home_score <> m.away_score then raise exception 'Skor eşit değil; maç bitirilebilir.'; end if; update public.matches set extra_time_at = now() where id = p_match_id; elsif p_action = 'start_shootout' then if m.status <> 'live' or m.second_half_at is null or m.shootout is not null then raise exception 'Penaltılara geçilemez.'; end if; if m.tiebreak is null then raise exception 'Bu maç eleme maçı değil.'; end if; if m.home_score <> m.away_score then raise exception 'Skor eşit değil; maç bitirilebilir.'; end if; update public.matches set shootout = '[]'::jsonb, home_pens = 0, away_pens = 0 where id = p_match_id; elsif p_action = 'finish' then if m.status <> 'live' or m.second_half_at is null then raise exception 'İkinci yarı oynanmıyor.'; end if; if m.tiebreak is not null and m.home_score = m.away_score and coalesce(m.home_pens, 0) = coalesce(m.away_pens, 0) then raise exception 'Eleme maçı berabere bitemez: önce uzatma veya penaltılar oynanmalı.'; end if; update public.matches set status = 'finished', is_completed = true where id = p_match_id; elsif p_action = 'undo' then if not public.owns_match(p_match_id) then raise exception 'Geri alma yalnızca admin veya turnuva sahibine açık.' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if m.status = 'finished' then update public.matches set status = 'live', is_completed = false where id = p_match_id; elsif m.status = 'live' and m.shootout is not null then update public.matches set shootout = null, home_pens = null, away_pens = null where id = p_match_id; elsif m.status = 'live' and m.extra_time_at is not null then update public.matches set extra_time_at = null where id = p_match_id; elsif m.status = 'live' and m.second_half_at is not null then update public.matches set status = 'halftime', second_half_at = null where id = p_match_id; elsif m.status = 'halftime' then update public.matches set status = 'live' where id = p_match_id; elsif m.status = 'live' then update public.matches set status = 'notStarted', kickoff_at = null where id = p_match_id; end; $$

v_last := v_disp[array_length(v_disp, 1)]; end if; insert into public.players (name, surname, birth_date) values (v_first, v_last, p_birth) returning id into v_player; insert into public.player_verifications (player_id, tc_hash, verified_by) values (v_player, v_hash, auth.uid()); insert into public.identity_events (player_id, action, user_id) values (v_player, 'create', auth.uid()), (v_player, 'verify', auth.uid()); end if; end if; select trim(coalesce(name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(surname, '')) into v_name from public.players where id = v_player; select * into v_cur from public.season_team_players where season_id = m.season_id and player_id = v_player order by is_active desc limit 1; if found and v_cur.is_active and v_cur.team_id <> p_team_id then raise exception '% bu sezon başka bir takımda kayıtlı.', v_name; end if; if found and v_cur.is_active then return jsonb_build_object('status', 'added', 'player_id', v_player, 'name', v_name); end if; if v_staff then if found then update public.season_team_players set team_id = p_team_id, is_active = true, jersey_number = coalesce(p_jersey, jersey_number) where id = v_cur.id; else insert into public.season_team_players (season_id, team_id, player_id, jersey_number, is_active) values (m.season_id, p_team_id, v_player, p_jersey, true); end if; return jsonb_build_object('status', 'added', 'player_id', v_player, 'name', v_name); end if; insert into public.pending_actions (action_type, season_id, team_id, payload) values ('roster_add', m.season_id, p_team_id, jsonb_build_object( 'player_id', v_player, 'player_name', v_name, 'match_id', p_match_id, 'jersey_number', p_jersey, 'via', 'identity')) on conflict do nothing; return jsonb_build_object('status', 'pending', 'player_id', v_player, 'name', v_name); end; $function$

create or replace function public._player_merge(p_keep uuid, p_drop uuid, p_force boolean) returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$ declare r record; kp public.players; dp public.players; rows_json jsonb := '[]'::jsonb; moved bigint; begin if p_keep = p_drop then raise exception 'Aynı kayıt seçildi.'; end if; select * into kp from public.players where id = p_keep; select * into dp from public.players where id = p_drop; if kp.id is null or dp.id is null then raise exception 'Kayıt bulunamadı.'; end if; if kp.auth_uid is not null and dp.auth_uid is not null then raise exception 'İki kaydın da giriş hesabı var; otomatik birleştirilemez.'; end if; -- Hesabı olan kayıt her zaman kalır. if dp.auth_uid is not null then raise exception 'Giriş hesabı olan kaydı silemezsiniz; onu tutan kaydı seçin.'; end if; if exists (select 1 from public.season_team_players a join public.season_team_players b on a.season_id = b.season_id where a.player_id = p_keep and b.player_id = p_drop) and not p_force then raise exception 'AYNI_SEZON'; end if; -- Yedek: silinecek kayıt ve bağlı kadro satırları. select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)), '[]'::jsonb) into rows_json from public.season_team_players s where s.player_id = p_drop; insert into public.player_merge_backup(kept_id, dropped_id, dropped_player, dropped_rows) values (p_keep, p_drop, to_jsonb(dp), rows_json); -- Bağlı tüm tabloları taşı; benzersizlik çakışırsa silinecek kaydın satırı atılır. for r in select c.conrelid::regclass as tbl, a.attname as col from pg_constraint c join pg_attribute a on a.attrelid = c.conrelid and a.attnum = any(c.conkey) where c.contype = 'f' and c.confrelid = 'public.players'::regclass loop begin execute format('update %s set %I = $1 where %I = $2', r.tbl, r.col, r.col) using p_keep, p_drop; exception when unique_violation then execute format('delete from %s where %I = $1', r.tbl, r.col) using p_drop; end; end loop; delete from public.players where id = p_drop; -- Tutulan kayıtta boş kalan alanlar silinen kayıttan tamamlanır. update public.players set phone = coalesce(kp.phone, dp.phone), photo_url = coalesce(kp.photo_url, dp.photo_url), preferred_foot = coalesce(kp.preferred_foot, dp.preferred_foot), main_position = coalesce(kp.main_position, dp.main_position), sub_position = coalesce(kp.sub_position, dp.sub_position), other_positions = coalesce(kp.other_positions, dp.other_positions), height = coalesce(kp.height, dp.height), weight = coalesce(kp.weight, dp.weight) where id = p_keep; delete from public.player_dup_dismissed where a in (p_keep, p_drop) or b in (p_keep, p_drop); end $$

create or replace function public.sms_otp_verify( p_phone text, p_code text, p_password text ) returns text language plpgsql security definer set search_path to '' as $$ declare v_raw text := public.phone_raw10(p_phone); v_code text := regexp_replace(coalesce(p_code, ''), '\D', '', 'g'); c public.sms_otp_codes%rowtype; v_uid uuid; begin if not public.sms_otp_enabled() then return 'disabled'; end if; if v_raw is null or v_raw !~ '^5[0-9]{9}$' then return 'invalid_phone'; end if; if p_password is null or length(p_password) not between 6 and 10 or p_password !~ '[^A-Za-z]' then return 'weak_password'; end if; select * into c from public.sms_otp_codes where phone_raw10 = v_raw and used_at is null order by created_at desc limit 1 for update; if not found or c.expires_at < now() then return 'expired'; end if; if c.attempts >= 5 then return 'too_many_attempts'; end if; if c.code_hash <> extensions.crypt(v_code, c.code_hash) then update public.sms_otp_codes set attempts = attempts + 1 where id = c.id; return case when c.attempts + 1 >= 5 then 'too_many_attempts' else 'wrong_code' end; end if; update public.sms_otp_codes set used_at = now() where id = c.id; v_uid := public.set_phone_account_password(v_raw, p_password, false); -- Bu numaranın eski akıştan kalan bekleyen talepleri kapanır. update public.account_requests set status = 'approved', user_id = v_uid, reviewed_at = now() where phone_raw10 = v_raw and status = 'pending'; return 'ok'; end; $$

create or replace function realtime.check_equality_op( op realtime.equality_op, type_ regtype, val_1 text, val_2 text, negate boolean ) returns bool stable -- uses EXECUTE, so cannot be immutable language plpgsql as $$ declare op_symbol text; res boolean; begin -- IS DISTINCT FROM / IS NOT DISTINCT FROM: infix, both sides typed literals if op = 'isdistinct' then execute format( 'select %L::%s %s %L::%s', val_1, type_::text, case when negate then 'IS NOT DISTINCT FROM' else 'IS DISTINCT FROM' end, val_2, type_::text ) into res; return res; end if; -- IS requires a keyword RHS (NULL, TRUE, FALSE, UNKNOWN), not a typed literal if op = 'is' then if val_2 not in ('null', 'true', 'false', 'unknown') then raise exception 'invalid value for is filter: must be null, true, false, or unknown'; end if; execute format( 'select %L::%s %s %s', val_1, type_::text, case when negate then 'IS NOT' else 'IS' end, upper(val_2) ) into res; return res; end if; op_symbol = case when op = 'eq' then '=' when op = 'neq' then '!=' when op = 'lt' then '<' when op = 'lte' then '<=' when op = 'gt' then '>' when op = 'gte' then '>=' when op = 'in' then '= any' when op = 'like' then 'LIKE' when op = 'ilike' then 'ILIKE' when op = 'match' then '~' when op = 'imatch' then '~*' else null end; if op_symbol is null then raise exception 'unsupported equality operator: %', op::text; end if; execute format( 'select %L::%s %s (%L::%s)', val_1, type_::text, op_symbol, val_2, case when op = 'in' then type_::text || '[]' else type_::text end ) into res; return case when negate then not res else res end; end; $$

create or replace function public.comment_moderate(p_body text) returns text language plpgsql stable set search_path to '' as $$ declare v_fold text := public.comment_fold(p_body); -- Kelime içi nokta/yıldız/tire atılır ("a.q", "s*k" → "aq", "sk"). v_tokens text[] := regexp_split_to_array( regexp_replace(v_fold, '[.*_\-]', '', 'g'), '[^a-zçğıöşü]+'); -- Yalnız harfler, bitişik: boşlukla bölünmüş küfrü yakalar. v_flat text := regexp_replace(v_fold, '[^a-zçğıöşü]', '', 'g'); v_tok text; v_letters int; v_upper int; -- Tam kelime eşleşmesi. c_exact constant text[] := array[ 'aq', 'amk', 'amq', 'mk', 'sg', 'sk', 'oç', 'oc', 'piç', 'pic', 'sik', 'göt', 'got', 'sktr', 'sktir', 'aw', 'awk', 'amcık', 'amcik', 'yarak', 'yarrak', 'ibne', 'ipne', 'gavat', 'kahpe', 'pezo', 'yavşak', 'yavsak', 'şerefsiz', 'serefsiz', 'orosbu', 'oruspu', 'kaltak', 'puşt', 'pust']; -- Bu köklerle başlayan kelime (tekrar eden harfler teke indiği için -- "yarrak" → "yarak"; "sıkıntı"yı Türkçe karaktersiz yazan takılmasın -- diye "sik" yalnız tam kelime). c_prefix constant text[] := array[ 'siktir', 'sikt', 'siker', 'sikey', 'sikiy', 'sikim', 'sikik', 'sikiş', 'sikis', 'amına', 'amina', 'amını', 'amini', 'amcığ', 'amcig', 'orospu', 'orosbu', 'yarak', 'yarağ', 'pezeven', 'göte', 'götün', 'götveren', 'gotveren', 'ibneler', 'kahpe', 'piçler', 'yavşa', 'yavsa', 'şerefsi', 'serefsi', 'gavatl', 'puşt', 'dalyarak', 'fahişe', 'fahise', 'sürtük', 'surtuk']; -- Bitişik metinde geçerse onaya (yanlış alarm olabilir). c_flat constant text[] := array[ 'amına', 'amina', 'siktir', 'orospu', 'yarak', 'pezeven', 'sikerim', 'sikiyim', 'anani', 'ananı', 'bacını', 'bacini']; -- Hakaret olabilecek kelimeler: onaya. c_soft constant text[] := array[ 'salak', 'aptal', 'gerizekalı', 'gerizekali', 'mal', 'dangalak', 'ahmak', 'haysiyetsiz', 'onursuz', 'şike', 'sike', 'şikeci', 'hırsız', 'hirsiz', 'satıldı', 'satildi', 'rüşvet', 'rusvet', 'köpek', 'kopek', 'eşek', 'esek', 'hayvan', 'ayı', 'öküz', 'okuz', 'lavuk', 'hıyar', 'hiyar', 'beyinsiz', 'aşağılık', 'asagilik', 'kaşar', 'kasar']; begin foreach v_tok in array v_tokens loop continue when v_tok = ''; if v_tok = any (c_exact) or exists (select 1 from unnest(c_prefix) p where v_tok like p || '%') then return 'blocked'; end if; end loop; if exists (select 1 from unnest(c_flat) f where v_flat like '%' || f || '%') then return 'pending:Küfür olabilir'; end if; foreach v_tok in array v_tokens loop if v_tok = any (c_soft) then return 'pending:"' || v_tok || '"'; end if; end loop; if p_body ~* '(https?://|www\.|\.com|\.net|\.org|t\.me/)' then return 'pending:Bağlantı'; end if; if regexp_replace(p_body, '\D', '', 'g') ~ '\d{7,}' then return 'pending:Telefon numarası'; end if; if p_body ~ '\*' then return 'pending:Gizlenmiş kelime'; end if; v_letters := char_length(regexp_replace(p_body, '[^[:alpha:]]', '', 'g')); v_upper := char_length(regexp_replace(p_body, '[^A-ZÇĞİÖŞÜ]', '', 'g')); if v_letters >= 10 and v_upper::numeric / v_letters > 0.7 then return 'pending:Tamamı büyük harf'; end if; return 'ok'; end; $$

create or replace function public.identity_candidates(p_first text, p_last text, p_birth date, p_tc text) returns table(player_id uuid, name text, surname text, birth_date date, photo_url text, teams text, match_kind text, verified boolean) language plpgsql security definer set search_path to '' as $function$ declare v_hash text; v_first text := public._id_fold(p_first); v_first1 text := split_part(public._id_fold(p_first), ' ', 1); v_last text := public._id_fold(p_last); v_wide boolean := public._identity_wide(); begin perform public._identity_guard(p_tc); insert into public.identity_events (action, user_id) values ('lookup', auth.uid()); v_hash := public._identity_hash(p_tc); return query with base as ( select p.*, v.tc_hash, public._id_fold(p.surname) as f_last, public._id_fold(p.name) as f_first, split_part(public._id_fold(p.name), ' ', 1) as f_first1 from public.players p left join public.player_verifications v on v.player_id = p.id ), c as ( select b.*, case when b.tc_hash = v_hash then 'tc' when b.birth_date = p_birth and b.f_last = v_last and (b.f_first = v_first or v_first like b.f_first || ' %' or b.f_first like v_first || ' %') then 'exact' when b.birth_date = p_birth then 'near' when b.f_last = v_last and b.f_first1 = v_first1 then 'year' else 'name' end as m from base b where b.tc_hash = v_hash or (b.birth_date = p_birth and (b.f_last = v_last or b.f_first1 = v_first1)) or (v_wide and b.f_last = v_last and b.f_first1 = v_first1) or (v_wide and extract(year from b.birth_date) = extract(year from p_birth) and extensions.levenshtein(b.f_first1, v_first1) <= 1) ), strong as ( select exists (select 1 from c where c.m in ('tc', 'exact', 'year')) as yes ) select c.id, c.name::text, c.surname, c.birth_date, c.photo_url, (select string_agg(distinct t.name, ', ') from public.season_team_players stp join public.teams t on t.id = stp.team_id where stp.player_id = c.id and stp.is_active), c.m, c.tc_hash is not null and c.tc_hash <> v_hash from c, strong where c.m <> 'name' or not strong.yes order by case c.m when 'tc' then 0 when 'exact' then 1 when 'year' then 2 when 'near' then 3 else 4 end, c.surname, c.name limit 10; end; $function$

create or replace function public.cup_sync_slot( b public.cup_brackets, p_stage int, p_slot int, p_round text, p_home uuid, p_away uuid ) returns public.matches language plpgsql security definer set search_path to '' as $$ declare m public.matches; begin select * into m from public.matches where cup_bracket_id = b.id and cup_stage = p_stage and cup_slot = p_slot order by created_at limit 1; if p_home is null or p_away is null then if found and m.status = 'notStarted' then delete from public.matches where id = m.id; return null; end if; return m; end if; if not found then insert into public.matches ( season_id, league_id, group_id, home_team_id, away_team_id, week, status, tiebreak, cup_name, cup_round, cup_bracket_id, cup_stage, cup_slot ) values ( b.season_id, b.league_id, b.group_id, p_home, p_away, b.base_week + p_stage, 'notStarted', b.tiebreak, b.cup_name, p_round, b.id, p_stage, p_slot ) returning * into m; elsif m.status = 'notStarted' and (m.home_team_id is distinct from p_home or m.away_team_id is distinct from p_away) then update public.matches set home_team_id = p_home, away_team_id = p_away where id = m.id returning * into m; end if; return m; end; $$

create or replace function public.push_send(p_user_ids uuid[], p_title text, p_body text, p_url text DEFAULT '/'::text, p_tag text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_force boolean DEFAULT false) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare v_secret text; v_kind text := nullif(split_part(coalesce(p_tag, ''), '-', 1), ''); v_ref text := nullif(substr(coalesce(p_tag, ''), length(coalesce(v_kind, '')) + 2), ''); v_push uuid[]; v_url text; v_paused jsonb; v_match uuid; v_scorer uuid; v_follow boolean; v_players uuid[]; v_league uuid; begin if p_user_ids is null then return; end if; -- Demo turnuvalardan hiçbir kullanıcıya bildirim gitmez. if public.push_ref_is_demo(v_kind, v_ref) then return; end if; begin insert into public.notifications (user_id, title, body, kind, ref_id) select distinct u, p_title, p_body, v_kind, case when v_ref ~* '^[0-9a-f-]{36}$' then v_ref::uuid end from unnest(p_user_ids) u where u is not null and exists (select 1 from auth.users au where au.id = u); exception when others then raise warning 'push_send notifications: %', sqlerrm; end; -- Geçici olarak telefona gönderilmeyen türler (uygulamadaki listede -- kalır). app_settings.push_paused_kinds; ilk yarı sonucu 'halftime'. if not p_force then select value into v_paused from public.app_settings where key = 'push_paused_kinds'; if coalesce(v_paused, '[]'::jsonb) ? (case when v_kind = 'live' and p_title = 'İlk yarı sonucu' then 'halftime' else coalesce(v_kind, '') end) then return; end if; end if; -- Zorunlu bildirimde tür anahtarı atlanır; ana anahtar kapalıysa gitmez. select coalesce(array_agg(distinct u), '{}') into v_push from unnest(p_user_ids) u where u is not null and case when p_force then coalesce( (select np.push_enabled from public.notification_prefs np where np.user_id = u), true) else public.notif_wants(u, coalesce(v_kind, '')) end; -- Geçici kısıt: futbolcu/yönetici değilse yalnız Takip Listem'den. if not p_force and cardinality(v_push) > 0 and coalesce( (select value from public.app_settings where key = 'push_players_only'), 'false'::jsonb) = 'true'::jsonb then if v_ref ~* '^[0-9a-f-]{36}$' then v_match := v_ref::uuid; end if; -- Takip Listem istisnası (takım sonucu / oyuncu golü); kapalıyken -- yalnız futbolcu ve yöneticiler. v_follow := coalesce( (select value from public.app_settings where key = 'push_follow_exceptions'), 'false'::jsonb) = 'true'::jsonb; begin v_scorer := nullif(current_setting('push.scorer', true), '')::uuid; exception when others then v_scorer := null; end; -- Golün oyuncuları (atan + asist yapan), virgülle. begin v_players := string_to_array( nullif(current_setting('push.players', true), ''), ',')::uuid[]; exception when others then v_players := null; end; if v_scorer is not null then v_players := array_append(coalesce(v_players, '{}'), v_scorer); end if; if v_match is not null then select league_id into v_league from public.matches where id = v_match; end if; select coalesce(array_agg(u), '{}') into v_push from unnest(v_push) u where exists ( select 1 from public.season_team_players stp join public.players p on p.id = stp.player_id where stp.is_active and p.auth_uid = u) or exists (select 1 from public.admins a where a.user_id = u) or exists (select 1 from public.league_owners o where o.user_id = u) or exists (select 1 from public.region_owners r where r.user_id = u) or exists (select 1 from public.team_managers t where t.user_id = u) or (v_follow and v_kind = 'result' and v_match is not null and exists ( select 1 from public.matches m where m.id = v_match and (exists (select 1 from public.user_follows uf where uf.user_id = u and uf.kind = 'team' and uf.target_id in (m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id)) or exists (select 1 from public.followed_teams f where f.user_id = u and f.team_id in (m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id))))) or (v_follow and v_kind = 'goal' and v_scorer is not null and exists ( select 1 from public.user_follows uf where uf.user_id = u and uf.kind = 'player' and uf.target_id = v_scorer)) -- Bildirim davetiyle açanlar (notification_prefs.opted_in_at): -- takip ettiği turnuvanın maçları, takımının sonucu, oyuncusunun -- golü / asisti. or (exists (select 1 from public.notification_prefs np where np.user_id = u and np.opted_in_at is not null) and ( (v_league is not null and v_kind in ('schedule', 'live', 'goal', 'result') and exists (select 1 from public.followed_leagues fl where fl.user_id = u and fl.league_id = v_league)) or (v_kind = 'result' and v_match is not null and exists ( select 1 from public.matches m where m.id = v_match and (exists (select 1 from public.user_follows uf where uf.user_id = u and uf.kind = 'team' and uf.target_id in (m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id)) or exists (select 1 from public.followed_teams f where f.user_id = u and f.team_id in (m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id))))) or (v_kind = 'goal' and v_players is not null and exists ( select 1 from public.user_follows uf where uf.user_id = u and uf.kind = 'player' and uf.target_id = any (v_players))) )); end if; if cardinality(v_push) = 0 or not exists ( select 1 from public.push_subscriptions where user_id = any (v_push) ) then return; end if; select value into v_secret from public.app_private_settings where key = 'push_secret'; if coalesce(v_secret, '') = '' then return; end if; -- Bildirime basınca ilgili ekran açılsın. v_url := case when p_tag is not null and coalesce(p_url, '/') = '/' then '/?n=' || p_tag else coalesce(p_url, '/') end; perform net.http_post( url := 'https://qxdjebzszikeslobrozf.supabase.co/functions/v1/send-push', body := jsonb_build_object( 'user_ids', to_jsonb(v_push), 'title', p_title, 'body', p_body, 'url', v_url, 'tag', p_tag ), headers := jsonb_build_object( 'Content-Type', 'application/json', 'x-push-secret', v_secret ) ); exception when others then raise warning 'push_send: %', sqlerrm; end; $function$

Futbolcu uygulamadan kayıt olsun; sonra listeden seçin.'; end if; if nullif(trim(coalesce(p_name, '')), '') is null then raise exception 'Ad gerekli.'; end if; if v_raw is not null and v_raw !~ '^5[0-9]{9}$' then raise exception 'Telefon no geçersiz.'; end if; if v_raw is not null then select id into v_id from public.players where public.phone_raw10(phone) = v_raw limit 1; if found then return v_id; end if; end if; -- Tüm bilgiler tek seferde: kadroya eklenmemiş oyuncuyu kurucu başkan -- sonradan güncelleyemez (owns_player). insert into public.players ( name, surname, birth_date, phone, main_position, sub_position, preferred_foot, height, weight, photo_url ) values ( trim(p_name), nullif(trim(coalesce(p_surname, '')), ''), p_birth, v_raw, nullif(trim(coalesce(p_main, '')), ''), nullif(trim(coalesce(p_sub, '')), ''), nullif(trim(coalesce(p_foot, '')), ''), p_height, p_weight, nullif(trim(coalesce(p_photo, '')), '') ) returning id into v_id; return v_id; end; $function$

create or replace function public.person_name_by_phone(p_phone text) returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path to '' as $$ declare v_raw text := public.phone_raw10(p_phone); v_uid uuid; v_name text; begin if not (public.is_admin() or public.is_any_league_owner()) then raise exception 'Yetkiniz yok.' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if v_raw is null or v_raw !~ '^5[0-9]{9}$' then return null; end if; select id into v_uid from auth.users where email = v_raw || '@masterclass.com'; -- Hesaba bağlı futbolcu profili, hesap adı, numarası kayıtlı futbolcu, -- sonra davet / takım sorumlusu kayıtları. select nullif(trim(concat_ws(' ', p.name, p.surname)), '') into v_name from public.players p where v_uid is not null and p.auth_uid = v_uid limit 1; if v_name is null and v_uid is not null then select nullif(trim(u.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'name'), '') into v_name from auth.users u where u.id = v_uid; end if; if v_name is null then select nullif(trim(concat_ws(' ', p.name, p.surname)), '') into v_name from public.players p where public.phone_raw10(p.phone) = v_raw order by p.created_at limit 1; end if; if v_name is null then select nullif(trim(full_name), '') into v_name from ( select full_name, created_at from public.league_owner_invites where phone_raw10 = v_raw union all select full_name, created_at from public.region_owner_invites where phone_raw10 = v_raw union all select t.manager_name, c.updated_at from public.team_manager_contacts c join public.teams t on t.id = c.team_id where c.phone_raw10 = v_raw ) i where nullif(trim(full_name), '') is not null order by created_at limit 1; end if; if v_name is null and v_uid is null then return null; end if; return jsonb_build_object('name', v_name, 'has_account', v_uid is not null); end; $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.news_push_notify() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare v_ids uuid[]; v_league text; v_league_id uuid; begin if not coalesce(new.is_published, false) then return new; end if; if tg_op = 'UPDATE' and coalesce(old.is_published, false) then return new; end if; select s.league_id, l.name into v_league_id, v_league from public.seasons s join public.leagues l on l.id = s.league_id where s.id = new.season_id; if v_league_id is null then return new; end if; with ids as ( select p.auth_uid as uid from public.season_team_players stp join public.seasons s on s.id = stp.season_id and s.is_active join public.players p on p.id = stp.player_id where s.league_id = v_league_id and stp.is_active union select tm.user_id from public.team_managers tm join public.seasons s on s.id = tm.season_id and s.is_active where s.league_id = v_league_id union select o.user_id from public.league_owners o where o.league_id = v_league_id union select f.user_id from public.league_followers f where f.league_id = v_league_id ) select array_agg(distinct uid) into v_ids from ids where uid is not null; perform public.push_send( v_ids, coalesce(v_league, 'Turnuva') || ' · Yeni haber', left(regexp_replace(coalesce(new.content, ''), '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 120), '/', 'news-' || new.id ); return new; end; $function$

create or replace function public.identity_verify(p_player_id uuid, p_first text, p_last text, p_birth date, p_tc text) returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path to '' as $function$ declare v_hash text; p record; v_other record; v_wide boolean := public._identity_wide(); v_name_ok boolean; v_wide_ok boolean; begin perform public._identity_guard(p_tc); v_hash := public._identity_hash(p_tc); select * into p from public.players where id = p_player_id; if not found then raise exception 'Profil bulunamadı.'; end if; v_name_ok := public._id_fold(p.surname) = public._id_fold(p_last) or split_part(public._id_fold(p.name), ' ', 1) = split_part(public._id_fold(p_first), ' ', 1); v_wide_ok := v_wide and ( (public._id_fold(p.surname) = public._id_fold(p_last) and split_part(public._id_fold(p.name), ' ', 1) = split_part(public._id_fold(p_first), ' ', 1)) or (extract(year from p.birth_date) = extract(year from p_birth) and extensions.levenshtein( split_part(public._id_fold(p.name), ' ', 1), split_part(public._id_fold(p_first), ' ', 1)) <= 1)); if not v_wide_ok then if p.birth_date is distinct from p_birth then raise exception 'Kimlikteki doğum tarihi profille eşleşmiyor.'; end if; if not v_name_ok then raise exception 'Kimlikteki ad soyad profille eşleşmiyor.'; end if; end if; select v.player_id, pl.name, pl.surname into v_other from public.player_verifications v join public.players pl on pl.id = v.player_id where v.tc_hash = v_hash and v.player_id <> p_player_id; if found then raise exception 'Bu kimlik başka bir profile onaylı: % %.', v_other.name, v_other.surname; end if; if exists (select 1 from public.player_verifications where player_id = p_player_id and tc_hash <> v_hash) then raise exception 'Bu profil başka bir kimlikle onaylı. Önce onayın kaldırılması gerekir.'; end if; if v_wide_ok then update public.players set birth_date = p_birth, name = case when public._id_fold(name) = public._id_fold(p_first) then name else initcap(lower(trim(p_first))) end, surname = case when public._id_fold(surname) = public._id_fold(p_last) then surname else initcap(lower(trim(p_last))) end where id = p_player_id and (birth_date is distinct from p_birth or public._id_fold(name) <> public._id_fold(p_first) or public._id_fold(surname) <> public._id_fold(p_last)); if found then insert into public.identity_events (player_id, action, user_id) values (p_player_id, 'correct: ' || coalesce(p.name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.surname, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.birth_date::text, '-'), auth.uid()); end if; end if; insert into public.player_verifications (player_id, tc_hash, verified_by) values (p_player_id, v_hash, auth.uid()) on conflict (player_id) do nothing; insert into public.identity_events (player_id, action, user_id) values (p_player_id, 'verify', auth.uid()); end; $function$

create or replace function public.set_player_other_positions( p_player_id uuid, p_positions text[] ) returns text[] language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$ declare v_main text; v_clean text[]; begin if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'Giriş yapmalısınız.' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if not public.positions_tab_allowed() then raise exception 'Bu özellik henüz açık değil.' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if not (exists (select 1 from public.players p where p.id = p_player_id and p.auth_uid = auth.uid()) or public.owns_player(p_player_id)) then raise exception 'Bu futbolcunun mevkilerini değiştiremezsiniz.' using errcode = '42501'; end if; select coalesce(nullif(trim(p.sub_position), ''), nullif(trim(p.main_position), '')) into v_main from public.players p where p.id = p_player_id; -- Tekrar ve asıl mevki ayıklanır, seçim sırası korunur. select coalesce(array_agg(x order by i), '{}') into v_clean from ( select x, min(i) i from unnest(coalesce(p_positions, '{}')) with ordinality as u(x, i) where nullif(trim(x), '') is not null and x is distinct from v_main group by x ) d; if not v_clean <@ array['Kaleci', 'Stoper', 'Bek', 'Defansif', 'Merkez', 'Ofansif', 'Kanat', 'Santrfor', 'Kanat Forvet']::text[] then raise exception 'Mevki geçersiz.'; end if; if cardinality(v_clean) > 3 then raise exception 'Asıl mevki dışında en çok 3 mevki seçilebilir.'; end if; update public.players set other_positions = v_clean where id = p_player_id; return v_clean; end; $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.telegram_act(p_chat_id bigint, p_action text, p_id uuid) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare v_user uuid; v_status text; v_grant jsonb; r public.profile_change_requests%rowtype; s public.player_merge_suggestions%rowtype; begin select user_id into v_user from public.telegram_links where chat_id = p_chat_id; if v_user is null then raise exception 'Bu Telegram hesabı bir kullanıcıya bağlı değil.'; end if; perform set_config( 'request.jwt.claims', jsonb_build_object('sub', v_user, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true ); if p_action in ('acc_ok', 'acc_no') then if not public.is_admin() then raise exception 'Bu talebi inceleme yetkiniz yok.'; end if; select status into v_status from public.account_requests where id = p_id for update; if v_status is null then raise exception 'Talep bulunamadı.'; end if; if v_status <> 'pending' then raise exception 'Talep zaten sonuçlanmış.'; end if; if p_action = 'acc_ok' then v_grant := public.approve_account_request(p_id); return v_grant || jsonb_build_object('status', 'approved'); end if; update public.account_requests set status = 'rejected', reviewed_by = v_user, reviewed_at = now() where id = p_id; return jsonb_build_object('status', 'rejected'); end if; if p_action in ('prof_ok', 'prof_no') then perform public.review_profile_change(p_id, p_action = 'prof_ok', null); select * into r from public.profile_change_requests where id = p_id; return jsonb_build_object( 'status', r.status, 'delete_photo', case when r.status = 'rejected' then r.changes ->> 'photo_url' when r.status = 'approved' and r.changes ? 'photo_url' and (r.previous ->> 'photo_url') like '%/media/profile_requests/%' then r.previous ->> 'photo_url' end ); end if; -- Geçici kod iletildi: hatırlatma durur (mesaja "✅ Onaylandı" eklenir). if p_action = 'otp_ack' then if not public.is_admin() then raise exception 'Yetkiniz yok.'; end if; update public.otp_telegram_reminders set done_at = coalesce(done_at, now()), code = null where otp_id = p_id; return jsonb_build_object('status', 'approved'); end if; -- Olası çift kayıt: birleştir / ayrı kişi. if p_action in ('dup_ok', 'dup_no') then if not public.is_admin() then raise exception 'Yetkiniz yok.'; end if; select * into s from public.player_merge_suggestions where id = p_id for update; if s.id is null then raise exception 'Öneri bulunamadı.'; end if; if s.status <> 'pending' then raise exception 'Bu öneri zaten sonuçlanmış.'; end if; if p_action = 'dup_ok' then perform public.merge_players(s.keep_id, s.drop_id); end if; update public.player_merge_suggestions set status = case when p_action = 'dup_ok' then 'merged' else 'rejected' end, decided_by = v_user, decided_at = now() where id = p_id; return jsonb_build_object( 'status', case when p_action = 'dup_ok' then 'approved' else 'rejected' end); end if; raise exception 'Bilinmeyen işlem.'; end; $function$

katılım sorgusu açılamaz.'; end if; select id into v_id from public.attendance_polls where match_id = p_match_id and team_id = p_team_id; if v_id is null then insert into public.attendance_polls (match_id, team_id, season_id, created_by) values (p_match_id, p_team_id, m.season_id, auth.uid()) returning id into v_id; create or replace function public.push_esame_reminders() returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path to '' as $$ declare r record; v_ids uuid[]; begin for r in with due as ( select m.id, m.season_id, m.match_time, m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id, coalesce(s.starting_player_count, 11) as need from public.matches m join public.seasons s on s.id = m.season_id where m.status = 'notStarted' and m.deleted_at is null and m.match_date between current_date - 1 and current_date + 1 and m.match_time ~ '^\d{1,2}:\d{2}' and ((m.match_date + left(m.match_time, 5)::time) at time zone 'Europe/Istanbul') between now() and now() + interval '45 minutes' -- Esame henüz açılmadıysa (açılış maç saati) hatırlatma anlamsız. and now() >= public.match_roster_open_at(m.id) ), sides as ( select d.id, d.season_id, d.match_time, d.need, d.home_team_id as team_id from due d union all select d.id, d.season_id, d.match_time, d.need, d.away_team_id from due d ) select sd.*, (select count(*) from public.match_rosters mr where mr.match_id = sd.id and mr.team_id = sd.team_id and mr.is_starting) as starters from sides sd where sd.team_id is not null and not exists (select 1 from public.esame_reminders er where er.match_id = sd.id and er.team_id = sd.team_id) loop insert into public.esame_reminders (match_id, team_id) values (r.id, r.team_id) on conflict do nothing; if r.starters >= r.need then continue; end if; select array_agg(distinct uid) into v_ids from ( select tm.user_id as uid from public.team_managers tm where tm.season_id = r.season_id and tm.team_id = r.team_id union select p.auth_uid from public.teams t join public.players p on p.id = t.manager_id where t.id = r.team_id ) x where uid is not null; perform public.push_send( v_ids, 'Esame girişini tamamlayın', public.match_title(r.id) || ' · ' || left(r.match_time, 5) || ' · İlk ' || r.need || ': ' || r.starters || ' / ' || r.need, '/', 'esame-' || r.id ); end loop; end; $$

create or replace function realtime.subscription_check_filters() returns trigger language plpgsql as $$ declare col_names text[] = coalesce( array_agg(a.attname order by a.attnum), '{}'::text[] ) from pg_catalog.pg_attribute a where a.attrelid = new.entity and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped and pg_catalog.has_column_privilege( (new.claims ->> 'role'), a.attrelid, a.attnum, 'SELECT' ); filter realtime.user_defined_filter; col_type regtype; in_val jsonb; selected_col text; begin for filter in select * from unnest(new.filters) loop if not filter.column_name = any(col_names) then raise exception 'invalid column for filter %', filter.column_name; end if; col_type = ( select atttypid::regtype from pg_catalog.pg_attribute where attrelid = new.entity and attname = filter.column_name ); if col_type is null then raise exception 'failed to lookup type for column %', filter.column_name; end if; if filter.op = 'in'::realtime.equality_op then in_val = realtime.cast(filter.value, (col_type::text || '[]')::regtype); if coalesce(jsonb_array_length(in_val), 0) > 100 then raise exception 'too many values for `in` filter. Maximum 100'; end if; elsif filter.op = 'is'::realtime.equality_op then -- `is` requires a keyword RHS rather than a typed literal if filter.value not in ('null', 'true', 'false', 'unknown') then raise exception 'invalid value for is filter: must be null, true, false, or unknown'; end if; -- IS NULL works for any type, but IS TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN require a boolean -- operand. Reject the non-null keywords on non-boolean columns here so they -- don't abort apply_rls at WAL time. if filter.value <> 'null' and col_type <> 'boolean'::regtype then raise exception 'is % filter requires a boolean column, got %', filter.value, col_type::text; end if; elsif filter.op in ('like'::realtime.equality_op, 'ilike'::realtime.equality_op) then -- like/ilike apply the text pattern operator (~~); reject column types that -- have no such operator instead of failing at WAL time if not exists ( select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_operator where oprname = '~~' and oprleft = col_type ) then raise exception 'operator % requires a text-compatible column type, got %', filter.op::text, col_type::text; end if; elsif filter.op in ('match'::realtime.equality_op, 'imatch'::realtime.equality_op) then -- match/imatch apply the regex operators ~ / ~*; reject column types that have -- no such operator (e.g. integer) instead of failing at WAL time, mirroring the -- like/ilike guard above. if not exists ( select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_operator where oprname = case when filter.op = 'imatch'::realtime.equality_op then '~*' else '~' end and oprleft = col_type and oprright = col_type and oprresult = 'boolean'::regtype ) then raise exception 'operator % requires a text-compatible column type, got %', filter.op::text, col_type::text; end if; -- validate the regex eagerly so a bad pattern is rejected here, not inside -- apply_rls where it would abort the WAL stream for the entity begin perform '' ~ filter.value; exception when others then raise exception 'invalid regular expression for % filter: %', filter.op::text, sqlerrm; end; else -- eq/neq/lt/lte/gt/gte: value must be coercable to the type perform realtime.cast(filter.value, col_type); end if; end loop; if new.selected_columns is not null then for selected_col in select * from unnest(new.selected_columns) loop if not selected_col = any(col_names) then raise exception 'invalid column for select %', selected_col; end if; end loop; end if; -- Apply consistent order to filters so the unique constraint can't be tricked by a -- different filter order. negate is part of the sort key. new.filters = coalesce( array_agg(f order by f.column_name, f.op, f.value, f.negate), '{}' ) from unnest(new.filters) f; new.selected_columns = ( select array_agg(c order by c) from unnest(new.selected_columns) c ); return new; end; $$

create or replace function public.get_live_draw(p_id uuid) returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path to '' as $$ declare d public.live_draws; v_elapsed numeric; v_revealed jsonb; v_current jsonb; v_byes jsonb; v_next numeric; begin select * into d from public.live_draws where id = p_id; if d.id is null or not public.can_view_league(d.league_id) then return null; end if; if d.status = 'scheduled' and now() >= d.end_at then perform public.finalize_live_draw(p_id); select * into d from public.live_draws where id = p_id; end if; v_elapsed := extract(epoch from (now() - d.start_at)); if d.status = 'cancelled' then v_revealed := '[]'::jsonb; else select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'w', (s->>'w')::int, 'h', s->>'h', 'a', s->>'a') order by ord), '[]'::jsonb) into v_revealed from jsonb_array_elements(d.steps) with ordinality as x(s, ord) where d.status = 'done' or (s->>'at')::numeric <= v_elapsed; -- Ev sahibi açıklanmış, rakip bekleniyor. select jsonb_build_object('w', (s->>'w')::int, 'h', s->>'h') into v_current from jsonb_array_elements(d.steps) s where d.status = 'scheduled' and (s->>'ht')::numeric <= v_elapsed and (s->>'at')::numeric > v_elapsed limit 1; -- Bay: haftanın son eşleşmesi açıklanınca. select coalesce(jsonb_agg(b), '[]'::jsonb) into v_byes from jsonb_array_elements(d.byes) b where d.status = 'done' or exists ( select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(d.steps) s where (s->>'w')::int = (b->>'w')::int ) and not exists ( select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(d.steps) s where (s->>'w')::int = (b->>'w')::int and (s->>'at')::numeric > v_elapsed ); -- Bir sonraki açıklama anı (istemci o an yeniden sorar). select min(t) into v_next from ( select (s->>'ht')::numeric t from jsonb_array_elements(d.steps) s union all select (s->>'at')::numeric from jsonb_array_elements(d.steps) s ) z where t > v_elapsed; end if; return jsonb_build_object( 'id', d.id, 'league_id', d.league_id, 'season_id', d.season_id, 'title', d.title, 'start_week', d.start_week, 'team_ids', to_jsonb(d.team_ids), 'total', d.total_matches, 'start_at', d.start_at, 'end_at', d.end_at, 'status', d.status, 'server_now', now(), 'revealed', v_revealed, 'current', v_current, 'byes', coalesce(v_byes, '[]'::jsonb), 'next_in', case when v_next is null then null else v_next - v_elapsed end ); end; $$

end if; -- Transfer: takım kaydı silinecek kayıttan kalacaksa tutulan kaydın aynı sezondaki satırı atılır. if p_team_from_drop then delete from public.season_team_players k where k.player_id = p_keep and k.season_id in (select season_id from public.season_team_players where player_id = p_drop); delete from public.player_dup_dismissed where a in (p_keep, p_drop) or b in (p_keep, p_drop); end $$

create or replace function public._otp_consume(p_raw text, p_code text) returns text language plpgsql security definer set search_path to '' as $function$ declare c public.sms_otp_codes%rowtype; m public.sms_otp_codes%rowtype; v_code text := regexp_replace(coalesce(p_code, ''), '\D', '', 'g'); begin -- Süresi dolmamış, kullanılmamış kodlardan herhangi biri geçer: kişi -- birkaç kez kod isteyince elle iletilen önceki kod da çalışır. select * into c from public.sms_otp_codes where phone_raw10 = p_raw and used_at is null and expires_at >= now() order by created_at desc limit 1 for update; if not found then return 'expired'; end if; if c.attempts >= 5 then return 'too_many_attempts'; end if; select * into m from public.sms_otp_codes where phone_raw10 = p_raw and used_at is null and expires_at >= now() and code_hash = extensions.crypt(v_code, code_hash) order by created_at desc limit 1; if not found then -- Yanlış deneme en yeni koda sayılır. update public.sms_otp_codes set attempts = attempts + 1 where id = c.id; return case when c.attempts + 1 >= 5 then 'too_many_attempts' else 'wrong_code' end; end if; -- Kullanılınca numaradaki diğer kodlar da geçersiz olur. update public.sms_otp_codes set used_at = now() where phone_raw10 = p_raw and used_at is null; return 'ok'; end; $function$

v_assist text; v_body text; v_to uuid[]; begin if new.event_type <> 'goal' then return new; end if; select id, status, home_team_id, away_team_id into v_m from public.matches where id = new.match_id; if v_m.id is null or v_m.status not in ('live', 'halftime') then return new; end if; select count(*) filter (where (e.team_id = v_m.home_team_id and not coalesce(e.is_own_goal, false)) or (e.team_id = v_m.away_team_id and coalesce(e.is_own_goal, false))), count(*) filter (where (e.team_id = v_m.away_team_id and not coalesce(e.is_own_goal, false)) or (e.team_id = v_m.home_team_id and coalesce(e.is_own_goal, false))) into v_home, v_away from public.match_events e where e.match_id = new.match_id and e.event_type = 'goal'; select trim(coalesce(name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(surname, '')) into v_scorer from public.players where id = new.player_id; select trim(coalesce(name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(surname, '')) into v_assist from public.players where id = new.assist_player_id; v_body := public.match_score_text(new.match_id, v_home, v_away) || E'\n' || coalesce(public.minute_label(new.minute, new.added_minute) || ' ', '') || coalesce(nullif(v_scorer, ''), 'Gol') || case when coalesce(new.is_own_goal, false) then ' (K.K.)' when coalesce(new.is_penalty, false) then ' (P)' else '' end || case when nullif(v_assist, '') is not null then ' (Asist: ' || v_assist || ')' else '' end; v_to := public.match_audience(new.match_id, false); if new.player_id is not null and not coalesce(new.is_own_goal, false) then v_to := v_to || coalesce(( select array_agg(uf.user_id) from public.user_follows uf where uf.kind = 'player' and uf.target_id in (new.player_id, new.assist_player_id)), '{}'); perform set_config('push.scorer', new.player_id::text, true); perform set_config('push.players', concat_ws(',', new.player_id::text, new.assist_player_id::text), true); end if; perform public.push_send(v_to, 'GOL!', v_body, '/', 'goal-' || new.match_id); perform set_config('push.scorer', '', true); perform set_config('push.players', '', true); return new; end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.register_player(p_phone text, p_code text, p_password text, p_first text, p_last text, p_birth date, p_tc text, p_main text, p_sub text, p_foot text, p_height integer, p_weight integer) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare v_raw text := public.phone_raw10(p_phone); v_first text := btrim(coalesce(p_first, '')); v_last text := btrim(coalesce(p_last, '')); v_hash text; v_player uuid; v_auth uuid; v_count int; v_uid uuid; v_res text; v_phone_owner uuid; begin if not public.self_registration_enabled() then return 'disabled'; end if; if v_raw is null or v_raw !~ '^5[0-9]{9}$' then return 'invalid_phone'; end if; if not public.tc_valid(p_tc) then return 'invalid_tc'; end if; if length(v_first) < 2 or length(v_last) < 2 or p_birth is null or p_birth < date '1940-01-01' or p_birth > (current_date - interval '10 years')::date or coalesce(p_main, '') not in ('Kaleci', 'Defans', 'Orta Saha', 'Forvet') or (p_sub is not null and p_sub not in ('Stoper', 'Sol Bek', 'Sağ Bek', 'Defansif', 'Merkez', 'Ofansif', 'Sol Kanat', 'Sağ Kanat', 'Santrfor', 'Sol Kanat Forvet', 'Sağ Kanat Forvet')) or (p_foot is not null and p_foot not in ('Sağ', 'Sol', 'Her İkisi')) or (p_height is not null and p_height not between 120 and 230) or (p_weight is not null and p_weight not between 35 and 200) then return 'invalid_data'; end if; if p_password is null or length(p_password) not between 6 and 10 or p_password !~ '[^A-Za-z]' then return 'weak_password'; end if; if exists (select 1 from auth.users where email = v_raw || '@masterclass.com') then return 'has_account'; end if; v_hash := public._identity_hash(p_tc); -- Aynı kişi: önce TC onayı, yoksa ad + soyad + doğum tarihi tutan -- onaysız profil. select v.player_id, p.auth_uid into v_player, v_auth from public.player_verifications v join public.players p on p.id = v.player_id where v.tc_hash = v_hash; if v_player is null then select count(*), min(p.id::text)::uuid into v_count, v_player from public.players p where (p.birth_date = p_birth -- Yalnız yılı bilinen profil (01.01): aynı yıl yeter. or (to_char(p.birth_date, 'MM-DD') = '01-01' and extract(year from p.birth_date) = extract(year from p_birth))) and (' ' || public._id_fold(v_last) || ' ' like '% ' || public._id_fold(p.surname) || ' %' or ' ' || public._id_fold(p.surname) || ' ' like '% ' || public._id_fold(v_last) || ' %') and (' ' || public._id_fold(v_first) || ' ' like '% ' || public._id_fold(p.name) || ' %' or ' ' || public._id_fold(p.name) || ' ' like '% ' || public._id_fold(v_first) || ' %') and not exists (select 1 from public.player_verifications v where v.player_id = p.id); if v_count > 1 then return 'ambiguous'; end if; if v_player is not null then select auth_uid into v_auth from public.players where id = v_player; end if; end if; if v_auth is not null then return 'profile_has_account'; end if; -- Numara başka bir profilde kayıtlıysa: ad soyad tutan onaysız profil -- o kişidir (bağlanır); tutmuyorsa numara başkasınındır. select p.id into v_phone_owner from public.players p where p.phone = v_raw; if v_phone_owner is not null and v_phone_owner is distinct from v_player then if v_player is null and exists ( select 1 from public.players p where p.id = v_phone_owner and p.auth_uid is null and (' ' || public._id_fold(v_last) || ' ' like '% ' || public._id_fold(p.surname) || ' %' or ' ' || public._id_fold(p.surname) || ' ' like '% ' || public._id_fold(v_last) || ' %') and (' ' || public._id_fold(v_first) || ' ' like '% ' || public._id_fold(p.name) || ' %' or ' ' || public._id_fold(p.name) || ' ' like '% ' || public._id_fold(v_first) || ' %') and not exists (select 1 from public.player_verifications v where v.player_id = p.id) ) then v_player := v_phone_owner; else return 'phone_taken'; end if; end if; v_res := public._otp_consume(v_raw, p_code); if v_res <> 'ok' then return v_res; end if; if v_player is null then insert into public.players ( name, surname, birth_date, phone, main_position, sub_position, preferred_foot, height, weight ) values ( v_first, v_last, p_birth, v_raw, p_main, p_sub, p_foot, p_height, p_weight ) returning id into v_player; else -- Mevcut profil: kişinin kendi girdikleri yazılır; ad profildeki gibi -- kalır, doğum tarihi kimlikteki tarihle düzelir. update public.players set phone = v_raw, -- Doğum tarihi kimlik çipindekiyle düzelir (aynı ad soyad ve -- tarihte başka profil yoksa; players_identity_uq). birth_date = case when exists ( select 1 from public.players o where o.id <> v_player and public.norm_person_name(o.name::text) = public.norm_person_name(name::text) and public.norm_person_name(o.surname) = public.norm_person_name(surname) and o.birth_date = p_birth) then birth_date else p_birth end, main_position = p_main, sub_position = case when p_main = 'Kaleci' then null else coalesce(p_sub, sub_position) end, preferred_foot = coalesce(p_foot, preferred_foot), height = coalesce(p_height, height), weight = coalesce(p_weight, weight) where id = v_player; end if; v_uid := public.set_phone_account_password( v_raw, p_password, false, v_first || ' ' || v_last); -- Hesap açılırken aynı numaralı başka bir kayıt bağlandıysa düzeltilir. update public.players set auth_uid = null where auth_uid = v_uid and id <> v_player; update public.players set auth_uid = v_uid where id = v_player; insert into public.player_verifications (player_id, tc_hash, verified_by) values (v_player, v_hash, v_uid) on conflict (player_id) do nothing; insert into public.identity_events (player_id, action, user_id) values (v_player, 'register', v_uid); return 'ok'; end; $function$

create or replace function public._interview_news_sync(p_match uuid, p_kind text) returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path to '' as $$ declare m record; v_list jsonb; v_first text; if m.id is null then return; end if; select jsonb_agg(public._video_json(v.id) order by v.created_at), (array_agg(v.url order by v.created_at))[1] into v_list, v_first from public.videos v where v.match_id = p_match and v.kind = p_kind; select id into v_news from public.news where auto_kind = 'interviews' and match_id = p_match and auto_data ->> 'kind' = p_kind limit 1; if v_list is null then if v_news is not null then delete from public.news where id = v_news; end if; return; end if; v_text := format('%s – %s: %s röportajları', m.home, m.away, v_label); if v_news is null then insert into public.news (season_id, week, match_id, auto_kind, content, link_url, auto_data, is_published) values (m.season_id, m.week, p_match, 'interviews', v_text, v_first, jsonb_build_object( 'kind', p_kind, 'home', m.home, 'away', m.away, 'home_id', m.home_id, 'away_id', m.away_id, 'home_logo', m.home_logo, 'away_logo', m.away_logo, 'logo', m.league_logo, 'videos', v_list), true) returning id into v_news; else update public.news set link_url = v_first, auto_data = coalesce(auto_data, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('videos', v_list, 'logo', m.league_logo) where id = v_news; end if; update public.videos set news_id = v_news where match_id = p_match and kind = p_kind and news_id is distinct from v_news; end; $$

-- Uygulama içi listeye herkes; telefona yalnız o türü isteyenler. create or replace function public.push_send( p_user_ids uuid[], p_title text, p_body text, p_url text default '/', p_tag text default null ) returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$ declare v_secret text; v_kind text := nullif(split_part(coalesce(p_tag, ''), '-', 1), ''); v_ref text := nullif(substr(coalesce(p_tag, ''), length(coalesce(v_kind, '')) + 2), ''); v_push uuid[]; v_url text; begin if p_user_ids is null then return; end if; begin insert into public.notifications (user_id, title, body, kind, ref_id) select distinct u, p_title, p_body, v_kind, case when v_ref ~* '^[0-9a-f-]{36}$' then v_ref::uuid end from unnest(p_user_ids) u where u is not null and exists (select 1 from auth.users au where au.id = u); exception when others then raise warning 'push_send notifications: %', sqlerrm; end; select coalesce(array_agg(distinct u), '{}') into v_push from unnest(p_user_ids) u where u is not null and public.notif_wants(u, coalesce(v_kind, '')); if cardinality(v_push) = 0 or not exists ( select 1 from public.push_subscriptions where user_id = any (v_push) ) then return; end if; select value into v_secret from public.app_private_settings where key = 'push_secret'; if coalesce(v_secret, '') = '' then return; end if; -- Bildirime basınca ilgili ekran açılsın. v_url := case when p_tag is not null and coalesce(p_url, '/') = '/' then '/?n=' || p_tag else coalesce(p_url, '/') end; perform net.http_post( url := 'https://qxdjebzszikeslobrozf.supabase.co/functions/v1/send-push', body := jsonb_build_object( 'user_ids', to_jsonb(v_push), 'title', p_title, 'body', p_body, 'url', v_url, 'tag', p_tag ), headers := jsonb_build_object( 'Content-Type', 'application/json', 'x-push-secret', v_secret ) ); exception when others then raise warning 'push_send: %', sqlerrm; end; $$
